We achieve this by combining our worldwide infrastructure with local expertise, through our global network of more than 250 proprietary offices and a team of over 3,000 dedicated professionals. Our diverse customer base includes owners and charterers in the oil, cruise, container, and bulk commodity sectors, as well as naval, government, and intergovernmental organizations. We have an ambitious growth model, and a career here is certainly going to be a rewarding one that will allow you to bring your skills & experience. We embrace change and are open to new thinking and pushing for positive change in our industry. Main Purpose of Job : To transform wireframes and UX concepts into high-fidelity, developer-ready UI designs for ISS’s complex B2B operational product ecosystem. Reporting to the UI/UX Lead, the UI Designer is responsible for creating polished, interactive artifacts that bridge the gap between UX discovery and front-end engineering. This role ensures our digital workflows are visually consistent, highly usable, and seamlessly handed off for technical execution. Duties and Responsibilities High-Fidelity Design & Prototyping Transform low-fidelity wireframes and UX concepts into pixel-perfect, high-fidelity user interfaces tailored for complex B2B web applications. Build advanced, interactive prototypes (using Figma) to simulate real-world system behavior for final usability testing and business sign-off. Apply excellent visual design skills to ensure complex data is displayed with clear hierarchy, readability, and minimal cognitive load. Design System & Standardization Partner directly with the UI/UX Lead to build, expand, and maintain a robust, centralized UI Component Library (Design System) that enforces a unified design language across all internal products. Define and document all UI states (hover, active, disabled, error) and responsive behaviors to ensure absolute consistency across the ecosystem. Developer Handoff & Agile Alignment Create meticulous design handoff documentation (redlines, spacing, interaction guidelines) to ensure front-end developers can build the UI without ambiguity or guesswork. Work deeply embedded within agile teams alongside Product Owners and developers, actively participating in sprint planning to review the feasibility of UI designs. title: AI Conversation Designer
description:
About ClearGrid
ClearGrid is revolutionizing the debt resolution industry with cutting-edge AI and advanced analytics. We leverage real-time data, machine learning, and automation to optimize debt recovery for financial institutions.
About The Role
Our AI agents hold thousands of conversations with customers every day, in Arabic and English, by voice and chat. We are looking for our first Arabic-speaking Conversation Designer: the person who makes sure the cultural and linguistic nuance of Arabic is a strength of our product, and that Arabic quality keeps pace with English as we scale.
You will join the conversation design team, reporting to the Conversation Design Manager, and lead the design of our Arabic AI agents: designing them, reviewing them, and setting the bar for what excellent Arabic sounds like in our product. You will be the team’s authority on Arabic conversation quality, and you will also contribute across the wider design workload: structuring requirements, designing conversations in both languages, and handing prompt engineers everything they need to build.
What you’ll own
Design conversations for new AI agents, voice and chat, for new and existing clients: conversation flows, dialogue structure, copy, and edge case handling.
Lead Arabic conversation design: design, review, and launch Arabic agents, and serve as the team’s authority on the linguistic and cultural quality of Arabic conversations.
Produce complete handover packages for prompt engineers: requirements, conversation designs, and guidelines that allow implementation to start without open questions.
Track and analyze agent performance with the analytics team, report on the impact of design changes, and recommend the next optimizations for each agent.
Run conversation quality reviews on live agents, covering the conversational quality dimensions that sit outside compliance QA.
Write and maintain our conversation design standards and methodology, and improve the internal processes the function runs on.
Your work directly influences our north-star metric: conversion of promises-to-pay into kept promises.
What we’re looking for
At least 1 year, ideally 2+, of conversation design experience on production chatbots and/or voice agents. Hands-on experience shipping a production bot is essential; pure UX copywriting without it is not enough for this role.
Arabic fluency with a deep feel for its linguistic and cultural nuances. You can hear what is off in a conversation and articulate why.
Comfort working with data: tracking, monitoring, and reporting on agent performance to prove the impact of your design decisions.
A high level of ownership and personal effectiveness. You thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments where structure is still being built.
Rigor and attention to detail. You treat documentation, reviews, and quality checks as core parts of the craft.
A curious, informed point of view on where voice AI and conversational interfaces are heading.
Nice to have
A background in Arabic linguistics.
Experience in fintech, collections, or outbound operations.
Hands-on experience with voice agents specifically.

This role sits within the Experience & Engagement stream and requires close collaboration with internal teams (Design, Research, Engineering, Data, and Business) to translate user insights into seamless, high-quality product experiences across Shahid’s web, mobile, and TV platforms.
Key responsibilities and accountabilities:
Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for user experience improvements across Shahid’s web, mobile, and TV applications.
Partner closely with UX/UI designers and researchers to translate user insights, usability testing, and behavioral data into actionable product requirements.
Own end-to-end user journeys — including onboarding, navigation, search, playback, and engagement flows — identifying friction points and opportunities for improvement.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Business, engineering, design, and marketing, to deliver high-quality experiences on time.
Manage product documentation, requirement gathering, and execution follow-ups for new features, experience enhancements, and design system adoption.
Define, run, and analyze A/B tests and experiments to validate design decisions and optimize the user experience.
Conduct market research, competitive benchmarking, and user feedback analysis to identify trends and opportunities for experience enhancements.
Analyze data to identify key experience metrics, user value, and journey performance, driving continuous optimization.
Champion accessibility, localization (including Arabic-first RTL experiences), and platform consistency across all user touchpoints.
Foster innovation and ensure efficient collaboration across teams.
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field; Master’s degree is an advantage.
7+ years in product management with a proven track record in consumer-facing digital or platform-based products.
Demonstrated experience improving user experience across multi-platform products (web, mobile, TV), ideally in streaming, media, or entertainment.
Strong analytical and data interpretation skills with hands-on experience in leveraging analytics and experimentation tools for decision-making.
Solid understanding of UX design principles, usability testing, user research methods, and design systems; familiarity with tools such as Figma is an advantage.
Experience in delivering use cases, journey maps, gap analysis, and functional requirements.
Experience in creating feature mock-ups, wireframes, prototypes, reports, and presentations when required.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to advocate for the user across the organization.
Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Knowledge of the broadcasting or streaming industry is an advantage; Arabic language skills and familiarity with MENA audiences are a plus.

title: Product Manager
description:
Who are we?
Eon Dental is a high-impact medical devices & tech company growing at neck breaking speed. We are a team of over ~500 colleagues dedicated to making Eon Dental a leading global player in the clear aligner and dental services industry.
Eon Dental aims to deliver value to dentists and orthodontists worldwide by offering a superior quality product, dynamic pricing, treatment schemes as well as after-sales service and assistance.
Software and innovation are involved in all aspects of our product lifecycle; beginning from an engaging experience on the frontend applications that serves customers and dentists to robust backend solutions for process management and automation.
Our excitement about the vision and mission of the company has enabled us to foster a great culture and an exciting work environment that is based on building synergies and our team’s exceptional talent to make our customers’ experience outstanding.
Your Impact
The Product Manager role is based in Amman, Jordan, and reports to the head of product management and will be responsible for owning the end-to-end product strategy and lifecycle for a product/set of products within Eon Dental’s portfolio. They will define the product vision, translate business and customer needs into a clear roadmap, and drive prioritization trade-offs to maximize both customer satisfaction and business impact. Operating cross-functionally with engineering, design, clinical, commercial, and go-to-market teams, they will lead discovery and delivery, ensure alignment across stakeholders, and drive execution from concept through launch and iteration. They will operate autonomously, influence portfolio-level decisions, and continuously evaluate product performance to inform strategic direction.
What You'll Do
Own the product strategy, roadmap, and prioritization for assigned products, aligned with business and customer goals.
Lead product discovery using customer insights, data, and market analysis to define high-impact initiatives.
Translate strategy into clear, actionable requirements and success metrics for engineering and design teams.
Partner closely with engineering to drive delivery, manage trade-offs, and ensure timely, high-quality execution.
Collaborate with design and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver intuitive, customer-centric solutions.
Own the product lifecycle from concept through launch and iteration.
Define and track key product metrics to assess performance and inform continuous improvement.
Support go-to-market alignment with sales, marketing, and customer-facing teams.
Provide guidance and mentorship to other Product Managers and, where applicable, take on direct people management responsibilities.
Adhere to the quality standards and safety procedures as per the company guidelines and local regulations.
Take appropriate actions in relation to any hazards and work-related issues, and escalate as needed, to ensure prompt and
effective resolution.
Perform other job-related tasks as assigned by the line manager to ensure the fulfillment of organizational objectives.
What To Bring
Bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, engineering, design, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
At least five years of product-management experience, including substantial ownership of digital products from discovery through launch and continuous improvement.
Demonstrated experience defining product strategy, managing roadmaps, prioritizing competing opportunities, and making evidence-based trade-offs.
Proven track record of delivering products or major product initiatives that produced measurable customer, operational, or commercial outcomes.
Ability to define meaningful product metrics, analyze performance, and use evidence to guide prioritization and iteration.
Strong stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders and align teams with different priorities.
Ability to operate autonomously, manage ambiguity, and maintain accountability across multiple product initiatives.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex product decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience working with product analytics, experimentation, customer research, and roadmap management tools.
Experience contributing to go-to-market planning, product launches, adoption initiatives, and commercial enablement.
What We Offer
Great culture and growth opportunity
The chance to personally impact Eon’s customer experience
Push your boundaries working with highly motivated and cross-functional teams
Interested?

You will be responsible for overseeing the entire product lifecycle, from concept to launch, and driving continuous improvement based on user feedback, market insights and cutting-edge AI technologies.
Strong candidates will have a background in shipping complex software products at scale and engaging with a global team to deliver high-quality, thoughtful product solutions to challenging user problems.
Your Responsibilities
Product Strategy and Roadmap Execution: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to define and execute the product vision and strategy for our suite of products designed for the MENA market. Oversee the end-to-end product development process for your team, from roadmap development to project prioritization to deployment and success monitoring. Ensure alignment with the company's global goals and values while accounting for local user needs and market trends.
AI Innovation: Identify opportunities for AI-driven innovation and differentiation, positioning Seesaw as a leader in intelligent learning solutions in the region. Spearhead the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) technologies into our educational products, leveraging data-driven insights to personalize learning experiences and optimize student outcomes.

User-Centric Design: Champion a user-centric approach to product development, leveraging data-driven insights to inform improvements, identify growth opportunities, and address pain points.
Market Analysis: Keep abreast of industry trends and competitor products across the MENA region. Conduct regular analyses to identify opportunities and areas for differentiation, driving improvements and innovation in Seesaw's MENA market product offerings.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field.

Proactive and robust product strategy development skills with a proven track record of leading small but mighty teams to deliver exceptional product experiences.

A passion for improving educational experiences for children across the MENA region and the globe.
Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, adapting to shifting priorities and business needs.
English and Arabic language expertise

Proficiency with project management tools and processes (Jira, Github, SCRUM), and product design tools and processes (Figma, User-centered design)

Product & Backlog Ownership

Translate business, regulatory, and operational needs into well-defined user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes.

Use customer feedback, analytics, operational insights, and market trends to identify product improvement opportunities.

title: Product Designer - UI/UX
description:
Design the interfaces for AI products used by governments and large enterprises across the GCC, at a level of craft that stands next to the best software being made anywhere, in two languages that read in opposite directions.
About Xpin AI
Xpin AI builds sovereign AI for governments, enterprises, and institutions across the GCC. Our products are bilingual at their core, spanning Arabic, English, and regional languages, and ship into both on-premise sovereign environments and cloud. Design here is a genuinely hard problem rather than a finishing layer: our users are making consequential decisions with a system whose output is probabilistic, so clarity, trust, and bilingual fluency are not polish, they are the product.
The role
You own the interface design for products across our suite. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will not be writing decks about design, you will be drawing the screens, building the components, and sitting with the engineers who ship them.
The bar is high and worth being explicit about. We are looking for the level of craft where typography, spacing, hierarchy, and motion are decided rather than defaulted, where the interface feels obvious to use and considered up close, and where nothing looks like it came out of a template. Most enterprise software in this region does not clear that bar. That is precisely the opening.
What you'll design
Product interfaces end to end.
Flows, screens, states, and the edge cases that never appear in a portfolio shot: empty, loading, partial, failed, and the long tail of real data.
Interfaces for probabilistic systems.
AI output is not deterministic. You will design how a system streams an answer, shows what it is doing and why, expresses confidence and uncertainty, and lets a user verify or correct it. There is little established pattern language here, so you will be defining it.
Real-time and voice experiences.
Conversational and voice-driven interfaces where timing, feedback, and interruption are part of the design rather than an afterthought.
Dense, information-heavy surfaces.
Dashboards and analytical views where the job is to make complexity legible for people who use the product all day, not to simplify it away.
The design system, alongside the Design Lead.
Components, tokens, and the typographic and spacing foundations, built in Figma so they translate cleanly into code rather than needing reinterpretation.
Bilingual design at system level.
Arabic and English as genuinely equal experiences: mirrored layouts, correct Arabic typography and numerals, type scales that work across two scripts with different rhythms and no shared italic convention. This is one of the hardest and most interesting parts of the job.
Motion with intent.
Transitions and micro-interactions that communicate state and causality, specified precisely enough to be built as designed.
What good looks like here
Typography is treated as a primary tool, not a setting. You have opinions about type scale, measure, and optical alignment, and you can defend them.
Spacing and layout follow a system you can articulate, and the system holds up under pressure rather than being abandoned on the hard screens.
Restraint. You know what to leave out, and your interfaces do not decorate to appear designed.
Your files are structured well enough that another designer or an engineer can pick them up without asking you what anything means.
You design the whole thing, including the states nobody screenshots.
Tool stack
Core design:
Figma at depth, including variables and modes, component properties and APIs, auto layout, library architecture, and Dev Mode for handoff.
Prototyping:
Figma prototyping for flows, with ProtoPie or Framer where an interaction needs real logic, timing, or conditional state to be evaluated properly.
Design systems and tokens:
Tokens Studio for token management, feeding a Style Dictionary pipeline maintained with our frontend engineers. Semantic token architecture, theming, and multi-mode systems that support both language directions.
Motion:
Rive or Lottie for production motion, authored so engineers implement what you designed rather than approximating it. After Effects where the pipeline calls for it.
Typography and localisation:
Arabic and Latin type pairing, variable fonts, type scales that hold across two scripts, RTL mirroring, bidirectional text behaviour, and font licensing suitable for embedded and offline distribution.
Accessibility:
WCAG 2.2 AA as a working standard, contrast and colour tooling such as Stark, keyboard and screen reader flows considered at design time rather than retrofitted.
Vector and assets:
Illustrator, Affinity, or equivalent for icon and mark work, custom icon system design, SVG optimisation, and asset formats that survive offline bundling.
Frontend literacy:
enough React, Next.js, Tailwind, and CSS logical properties to design within real constraints, read a component implementation, and have a precise conversation about why something rendered differently than drawn.
Collaboration and documentation:
Figma Dev Mode alongside Storybook, Git and GitHub at the level of reviewing a token or component change, and clear written specs and design system documentation.
Research and validation:
usability testing and structured critique, with tools such as Maze or UserTesting where the question warrants it.
Exploration:
whatever gets you to a better answer faster, including AI tooling for early ideation, provided the final work is deliberate rather than generated.
Level and scope
Mid to Senior, roughly five or more years designing digital products. What matters is the work: we will hire a designer with four years and an exceptional portfolio over one with ten and a competent one. You will own the design of your assigned product areas, work directly with product managers and engineers, and have real influence on what gets built, not just how it looks. This is a craft role with a path to grow.
Must-have
A portfolio of shipped product work with visible craft: considered typography, deliberate spacing and hierarchy, and interfaces that hold up when you look closely. This is the primary filter and we will look carefully.
Depth in Figma, including component architecture, variables, and building for reuse rather than assembling one-off screens.
Experience designing complex or information-dense applications rather than only marketing sites or simple consumer apps.
Design systems experience: you have built or meaningfully contributed to one and understand tokens, not just component libraries.
Ability to explain your decisions. You can walk through why a layout is the way it is, in terms a non-designer can follow, and change your mind when the argument is better.
Comfort working closely with engineers, and interest in how the thing actually gets built.
Based in the UAE or willing to relocate to Dubai, and comfortable working on-site.
Nice-to-have
Arabic or RTL design experience, including Arabic typography. Arabic language ability is a plus but not required.
Design for AI products: conversational interfaces, streaming responses, agent transparency, or voice.
Motion design produced to a production standard using Rive or Lottie.
Accessibility practice against WCAG standards, which our public sector deployments require.
Enterprise, government, or other complex operational software, where users are trained and constraints are real.
Data visualisation and dashboard design at scale.
Ability to build a working prototype in code, or comfort in a design engineering role.
Experience designing under offline constraints, including font licensing and asset bundling.
Why join
Very little software in this region is designed to the standard we are aiming for, and the products here are worth the effort: AI systems that people use to make real decisions, in a language pairing most design teams never seriously attempt. The Arabic and English problem alone is a body of work most designers never get to do properly.
You will work alongside an engineering team that cares about implementation fidelity, on a design system being built from the foundations rather than inherited. Your work ships into real government and enterprise environments across the GCC rather than into a backlog, and you will be close enough to the engineering to see it built the way you drew it.
Compensation and logistics
On-site in Dubai. Compensation is competitive and benchmarked to your experience and the UAE market. The package includes UAE employment visa sponsorship, medical insurance, and annual leave and flight allowance per UAE labour law and company policy. Relocation support is available for candidates joining from outside the UAE. Xpin AI hires on demonstrated ability and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.
How to apply
Send your portfolio. For this role it matters more than anything else on your CV, so lead with your best three to five pieces of shipped product work rather than everything you have made. We want to see the reasoning as well as the outcome: what the problem was, what you tried, what you cut, and what you would change now. Case studies with process beat galleries of finished screens. If you have a personal project that represents your ceiling better than your client work does, include it. We review portfolios properly and will give you a real response either way.

We're looking for a skilled and confident Senior UX Designer to join our Customer Experience team in an embedded capacity with one of Saudi Arabia's leading banks. This is a hybrid role that sits at the intersection of product thinking and visual craft, you'll be involved in shaping what gets built
and
how it looks and feels.
You'll be working within the client's Riyadh office, collaborating directly with their product and design teams day-to-day, while remaining a valued member of the VML agency team, joining department meetings, contributing to team culture, and benefiting from the development and support structures the agency provides.
This is a rare kind of embedded role. The client is mature from a design perspective, with a well-established design system, a product-oriented mindset, and a working culture that genuinely respects and enables good design. You'll have the conditions to do your best work.
You'll spend your time contributing to product definition, understanding user needs, shaping product direction, and designing experiences, as well as producing high-quality UI that works within and extends an established, comprehensive design system. You'll be one part product designer, one part visual craftsperson, and entirely focused on delivering experiences that serve millions of banking customers across the Kingdom.
What you'll do
Contribute to the definition and shaping of digital banking products, working alongside product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to clarify requirements and translate them into experience solutions.
Design intuitive, considered user flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity UI that align to the client's established design system.
Apply and work confidently within an existing design system, using components correctly, maintaining visual consistency, and flagging genuine gaps to the appropriate system owners.
Translate business and user requirements into clear, well-reasoned design solutions that balance user needs with commercial and technical constraints.
Collaborate with a cross-functional client team including product managers, developers, and other designers, contributing meaningfully to sprint cycles and product planning.
Communicate design decisions with clarity and confidence to stakeholders, backing up recommendations with evidence and rationale.
Work across multiple product areas or features simultaneously, managing your own time and priorities in a fast-paced product environment.
Participate in regular VML department meetings and contribute to the wider CX team's knowledge sharing, culture, and development.
You will have
6+ years of experience in UX and product design, with a portfolio that demonstrates both strong product thinking and high-quality visual design.
Proven experience working in a product environment within a corporate or enterprise organisation, you understand how products are built, how teams are structured, and how to work effectively in that context.
Solid experience working with and applying a comprehensive, established design system, you respect the system, work within it effectively, and know how to flag exceptions without undermining consistency.
Experience with user research, whether you've led it yourself or contributed as part of a team, you're comfortable with qualitative methods and using insight to inform design.
The ability to contribute at both the definition and execution stages of a product, you're as comfortable in a discovery workshop as you are in Figma refining a final screen.
Strong visual design skills with a clear eye for detail, hierarchy, and consistency.
Experience collaborating directly with clients and client-side teams, building relationships and working with autonomy and professionalism.
The ability to work independently in an embedded setting while remaining connected to and contributing to a wider agency team.
Experience in financial services, banking, or similarly regulated, large-scale product environments is a strong advantage.
You will be
Based in Riyadh, or willing to relocate
A native Arabic speaker
Willing to dedicate normal working hours (9-6), not in parallel with other working commitments.
Willing to spend time in the office each working day.
About The Team
You'll be joining VML's 20+ strong MENA CX department, spread across three countries and made up of visual designers, UX architects, researchers, and strategists. Although you'll be embedded with the client in Riyadh, you'll remain a full member of our team, attending regular department meetings, contributing to our culture, and benefiting from the skills frameworks, mentorship, and growth opportunities the agency offers.
The client environment itself is one of the best you'll find in the region. This is a design-mature organisation that has invested seriously in product and design capability. They have an established design system, a collaborative team culture, and a genuine respect for the value of good design. You'll have the support of both the client team around you and the VML agency behind you.
Why This Role is Different
Embedded agency roles can vary enormously. This one stands out. The client is experienced, design-forward, and committed to building products the right way. You won't be fighting for a seat at the table, design already has one. You'll be working in a well-structured product environment with a design system that works, a team that collaborates, and stakeholders who understand what UX is for.
At the same time, you'll keep the benefits of being part of an agency, variety, community, development frameworks, and a team of specialists to learn from and grow alongside.
If you're a hybrid designer who wants to work on products that matter, in an environment that enables great work, and with the backing of both a world-class client and a leading global agency, we'd love to hear from you.
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

title: Product Manager
description:

is a groundbreaking rent-now-pay-later platform reshaping the rental landscape in Saudi Arabia. We're dedicated to making rentals more accessible and affordable, enabling tenants to manage their finances with ease and landlords to secure their income effortlessly. We're on a mission to revolutionize the rental industry, breaking down barriers and creating opportunities for all. We're a team of innovators, thinkers, and problem-solvers, committed to creating a positive impact and driving change in the market.
Our Team
We love working together, being creative, and doing things differently! Our team is made up of people with different nationalities. We work from a cozy office in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. And hey, we're not just smart, we're really good at coming up with new ideas!
Our core values & Principles
Innovation – We’re a technology-driven team with the purpose of uplifting the real estate sector. We are the leaders of the industry in innovation.
Customer Centricity – We put the customer at the core of every decision and action.
Adaptability - Being able to adapt quickly to changing market conditions and customer needs.

Job Summary
At Rize, we're transforming the rental experience, and we're looking for a
Product Manager
to help bring that vision to life. In this role, you'll work closely with cross-functional teams to support product planning, improve user experiences, and help turn customer insights into impactful features.
From managing the product backlog to assisting in launches and performance tracking, you’ll play a key role in shaping solutions that empower both tenants and landlords. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who's looking to grow in a fast-paced, purpose-driven environment.
What will you be doing?
As a Product Manager, you'll be at the forefront of our product innovation. Your role will be dynamic and impactful, involving:
Support Product Strategy: Work with the team to help define product goals and priorities that support our mission.
Understand User Needs: Assist in gathering and analyzing user feedback, market trends, and competitive insights to guide product decisions.
Manage the Backlog: Help maintain a clear, organized product backlog and contribute to sprint planning.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work closely with engineering, design, operations, and marketing teams to ship new features and improvements.
Track Performance: Support product analytics efforts, help monitor KPIs, and identify opportunities for iteration.
Ensure Smooth Launches: Contribute to product testing, QA, and rollout planning to ensure high-quality delivery.

You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, or a related field.
You have at least 1-3 years of experience in product management, preferably a BNPL, Prop-tech, fintech, or tech startup.
You understand Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and thrive in a collaborative environment.
Experience with tools like JIRA, Figma, Notion, or Confluence is a plus.
A user-focused mindset with attention to detail and a desire to build great experiences
You have excellent communication skills, enabling you to influence and inspire across all levels of the organization.

What do we offer?
Competitive salary - Receive a competitive salary package in USD or SAR, reflecting your skills and contributions in our industry.
Diverse International team - Join a diverse international team where different perspectives and backgrounds enrich our collaborative culture
Innovation - Shape the future of Proptech with your groundbreaking ideas and technological prowess.
Direct Impact - See your ideas come to life and make tangible changes in an industry ripe for revolution.
Fast-paced Learning - Grow personally and professionally every day with opportunities to master new skills in our dynamic start-up environment.
Creative Freedom - Take the reins, innovate, and push boundaries with the freedom to experiment, learn, and grow at Rize.

title: BIM / CAD Modeler (Revit)
description:
About The Company
At Flow, we’re reimagining what it means to live, work, and connect. More than just a real estate company, Flow is a brand, a technology platform, and an operations ecosystem spanning condominiums, hotels, multifamily residences, and office spaces. We’re building a new kind of living experience: one that’s flexible, connected, and designed to create genuine community and real value for the people who call Flow home.
Our mission is oneness: prioritizing our residents and their experiences, and fostering connection with ourselves, their neighbors, and the natural world. By putting people at the center of everything we do, we’re creating vibrant, human-centered communities where life, work, creativity, and play all come together in one place.
About The Role
We are looking for a highly capable
BIM/CAD Modeler
with a specialized focus on
Interior Design and Technical Detailing
. You will support the design and delivery of Flow’s projects across the MENA region, translating ambitious design intent into highly accurate, coordinated Revit BIM models and CAD documentation.
The ideal candidate possesses a "design eye" and understands that a great model is more than just geometry, it’s about the fine details of joinery, material transitions, and furniture integration. You will be the bridge between conceptual interior design and technical execution.
Core Responsibilities
Detailed Modelling: Develop and maintain Revit BIM models specifically for high-end architectural and interior design packages.
ID Documentation: Produce comprehensive Interior Design construction packages, including furniture plans, floor finishes, reflected ceiling plans (RCP), power, lighting, plumbing, elevations, and section details.
Joinery & Millwork: Create detailed drawing packages for bespoke joinery, kitchens, and furniture, ensuring technical feasibility and design alignment.
Scheduling & Tagging: Prepare and manage complex schedules for doors, windows, ironmongery, and joinery.
Specification Integration: Interpret FF&E (Furniture, Fixtures & Equipment) and material specifications provided by the design team, ensuring all items are correctly coded, tagged, and reflected in the Revit model and drawing sets.
Coordination: Facilitate "clash-free" design by coordinating interior elements with structural and MEP disciplines within the BIM environment.
Standards Management: Maintain Revit families and templates, ensuring all ID-specific components (furniture, lighting, finishes) align with Flow’s BIM protocols.
Compliance: Ensure all drawings comply with local Saudi building codes and Flow’s internal design standards.
Qualifications
Education: Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Architecture, Architectural Technology, Engineering, Interior Design or related field.
Experience: 3-6 years of experience, with a proven track record in Interior Design documentation and high-end real estate or hospitality projects.
Software Mastery: Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Revit & AutoCAD is mandatory, with a strong knowledge of AutoCAD for 2D drafting.
Experience working in BIM environments, including model coordination and LOD development.
Technical Knowledge: Strong understanding of furniture construction, millwork detailing, and how different materials (stone, wood, metal) interface in an interior setting.
BIM Fluency: Experience in model coordination, LOD (Level of Development) 300-400, and working within shared CDE (Common Data Environments).
Bonus Skills: Familiarity with Navisworks, Rhino, or SketchUp.
Ability to work in fast-paced development environments with multiple concurrent projects.
Excellent organizational and communication skills.
What We Look For
Precision & Artistry: A meticulous eye for detail—you spot a 5mm misalignment before anyone else does.
Detail-oriented thinkers who take pride in precision and clarity in technical documentation.
Technical Sensitivity: The ability to read a material spec sheet and understand exactly how to tag and represent it in a technical drawing.
Collaborative Spirit: A team player who enjoys the "back-and-forth" with designers and engineers to solve complex site problems.
People who are energized by building something new and meaningful.
Individuals who combine technical discipline with design sensitivity.
Why Join Flow?
Exciting growth opportunity:
Be part of a fast-growing company shaping the future of residential living in the Middle East.
Competitive Compensation & Benefits.
A chance to make an impact:
Help build a vibrant international community and redefine what it means to call Flow home.
If you have the energy, talent, and work ethic to thrive in this role, we want to hear from you! Apply now and be part of Flow’s success story!

title: Forward Deployed Creative [KSA]
description:
You'll be Luma's creative lead on the ground with major brands and agencies, turning what our models can do into production workflows they actually use. Sitting between the technology and the craft, you'll shape how top creators work with generative video, and produce high-craft work in Dream Machine yourself as the proof.
This is the first Forward Deployed Creative role in the region, so you'll be defining how partner engagement works here rather than following a set playbook. It fits a senior creative who's comfortable shaping the approach as they go and consulting directly with senior partners. If you'd rather execute an established process, this isn't the fit.
What You'll Own
Partner directly with leading brands and creative agencies as their creative and strategic guide to generative AI.
Architect and prototype AI-accelerated production workflows that help partners move faster and raise their storytelling.
Create hands-on, high-craft content in Dream Machine that sets the bar and becomes inspirational case studies.
Consult with partner leadership, translating technical capability into concrete creative and business opportunities.
Work as an on-the-ground extension of Product, Partnership, and Sales, bringing real-world insight back into the roadmap.
Set the tone and the playbook for how the Forward Deployed Creative function engages partners in the region.
First 90 Days
One way the first 90 could unfold.
Days 1–30 — Immerse & Diagnose: Learn Dream Machine and the models deeply, meet priority partners, and understand their pipelines and where generative AI helps most.
Days 30–60 — Ship & Validate: Build a real AI-accelerated workflow with a partner and produce a high-craft case study from it.
Days 60–90 — Scale & Systemize: Turn what works into repeatable boards and playbooks other FDCs and partners can use.
What You Bring
Senior client-facing creative experience (Creative Technologist, Technical Director, or similar) at a top agency, studio, or tech company.
An outstanding portfolio of shipped, high-craft work showing taste, technical skill, and storytelling. A portfolio is required.
Deep expertise in creative production pipelines (VFX, animation, motion graphics, or production) and designing new workflows.
A track record of building new things in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
Exceptional communication and presentation, able to act as a strategic consultant to senior creative and business leaders.
Genuine enthusiasm for the creative potential of AI.
Nice to Have
Hands-on experience with generative AI creative tools (Midjourney, Runway, Pika, Stable Diffusion).
A public profile as a creator or thought leader in emerging tech or generative art.
Experience at an innovative agency (e.g. Buck, The Mill) or an in-house tech/brand lab (e.g. Google Creative Lab, Apple Marcom).
Note: this body applies to the Forward Deployed Creative roles in Germany (Munich), KSA (Riyadh), and US (LA/NY/SF) — Ashby handles the location per posting.
About Luma: Luma's mission is to build unified general intelligence that can generate, understand, and operate in the physical world. We believe multimodality is critical for intelligence — the next step beyond language models comes from vision. Luma is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Senior UX Researcher
description:
About Jeeny:
Jeeny is a mobile application that eases daily commuting and transportation. By connecting you with your preferred mode of transportation, we are fulfilling our aim of making mobility accessible, affordable, and flexible for all.
We are a joint venture between MEIG (Middle East Internet Group), Rocket Internet, and IMENA. Jeeny was established in 2014 as Easy Taxi. However, in 2016, it was revamped as Jeeny to cater to other services. Currently, we are operational in Saudi Arabia and Jordan.
We have offices in Riyadh, Jeddah, Madinah, Dammam, Khobar, Amman, Lahore, and Karachi.
Job Brief:
As a
Senior UX Researcher
, you will help bring the voice of drivers and customers into product decisions. You'll work closely with product, design, and data teams to generate insights that improve the overall mobility experience.
This is a key role in building a strong research practice and establishing continuous feedback loops with our users.
Key Responsibilities:
Plan and conduct qualitative and quantitative research (interviews, field studies, surveys, usability testing)
Build and manage a panel of drivers and riders for continuous feedback
Translate research findings into clear, actionable insights
Partner with product managers and designers during discovery and validation phases
Identify key user pain points and opportunities across the driver and rider journey
Support product decisions with data-driven insights and research findings
Contribute to building research processes, documentation, and knowledge sharing
Requirements
4+ years of experience in UX Research or a related field
Fluent in Arabic and English
Strong experience in qualitative research and user interviews
Good understanding of quantitative research methods, including surveys and data analysis
Ability to communicate insights clearly to cross-functional teams
Experience working closely with product and design teams
Experience presenting or collaborating with leadership, operations, data, and customer support teams
Experience in mobility, ride-hailing, travel, or marketplace products
Experience conducting field research with operational users (e.g., drivers, couriers)
Familiarity with analytics tools and behavioural data
Benefits
What We Offer:
An opportunity to collaborate with talented individuals while learning, growing, and expanding your skill set
An environment that encourages you to take ownership and produce excellent outcomes every day
Health benefits and insurance
Flexible working hours
Company Culture
Jeeny is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing a workplace where all aspects of employment are solely based on merit. We value diversity and absolutely do not discriminate in any form based on race, color, ethnicity, nationality, religion, gender, age, or mental or physical disability.

Achieve sales targets.

Stay updated on furniture and interior design trends.

Saudi National.
Bachelor's degree or diploma in Interior Design or a related field.
Experience in furniture, home décor, or interior design sales is preferred.

title: Product Designer
description:
At Procreate we're dedicated to making exceptional creative tools by combining beautiful user experiences with high performance engineering! Used by millions around the globe, Procreate is committed to placing more power in the hands of creatives.
We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our team here in Hobart. You’ll collaborate to deliver incredibly powerful tools through user friendly and intuitive user interfaces. Every aspect of our product design is meticulously thought through and iterated. Your approach to design will reflect this pursuit of excellence and relentless attention to detail.
The role
This role sits within the Product team, and you’ll report directly to the CPO, Claire d’Este. You’ll work closely with the CEO, Co-Founder, and Chief Product Designer, James Cuda. You’ll also work with other designers in both the product and marketing departments as well as our software engineers.
You’ll bring a skill set which combines technical fluency in a range of software tools, a creative flair, an ability to ideate, and a drive to design industry-leading products. You’ll work directly on Procreate as it continues to evolve and our next generation products.
What you'll do
Create and document processes and procedure.
Build out our design system, workflow and component library.
Maintain and build upon our existing design principles and language.
Work with designers, engineers and creatives to produce work of the highest quality.
Create beautiful and intuitive user experience. In your role, you’ll take big-picture ideas from concept to design.
Design a range of digital components that will improve design efficiency and allow designers to work within a consistent framework.
Skills
A background and significant experience in design. We appreciate a multi-disciplinary approach to design and value technical proficiency coupled with an ability to be creative, curious and playful. Your work will demonstrate how you have included elements of graphic design, motion design, and animation into the UX/UI of a range of digital products.
Creative flair and an inquisitive approach to design. Our aim is to engage, delight and spark joy in our users. Your work will sit squarely at the apex of functionality and aesthetics. You’ll be able to harness your technical proficiency, passion for design and a creative X-factor to execute a wide range of design deliverables.
A focus on detail and a desire to grow. It is important to us that you have a laser-like eye for detail and a hunger to learn. You’ll have the ability to collaborate with a diverse group of designers and engineers to produce pixel perfect work. Your ability to focus on the iteration and reiteration of high-fidelity prototypes alongside your colleagues will be crucial to your success in this role.
What to expect in the first 6-12 months
Complete the Procreate onboarding process and get to know your colleagues.
Build an understanding of our product design practices, processes and frameworks.
Establish relationships with inter-departmental key stakeholders.
Prepare and support the execution of key design projects.
Become an integral and contributing part of the Product Design Team and ship product.
We want to hear from you
We’d love to hear about how you see yourself contributing to Procreate in this role. Please note, we're looking for full-time and on-site employees for our Hobart or Sydney office. Apply now to be considered for the role!

title: Product designer
description:
Hungry for a challenge?
That’s good, because at SKIP we have abundant opportunity or, as we say, everything is on the table. We are a leading global online food delivery marketplace. Our tech ecosystem connects millions of active customers with hundreds of thousands of connected partners in countries across the globe.
Our mission? To empower every food moment around the world, whether it’s through customer service, coding or couriers.
About This Role
As a Product Designer at SKIP, you'll be part of a UX team looking after the apps and websites our customers and partners use for delivery of food, groceries and more!
You’ll work with an empowered cross-functional team that prioritises using research and data to help understand the problem space, before moving through the design process to deliver engaging and user-friendly solutions.
We want to discover what our users will love as soon as we can. We like to explore user problems in-depth and we like to speak with users regularly, to explore what we are working on and help us understand their needs.
You'll be part of a passionate UX team of 80+ UX designers, UI designers, product designers, service designers, researchers and writers across 7 countries.
These are some of the key ingredients to the role:
Focus on key user problems and come up with innovative solutions to those problems.
Quickly yet thoroughly create process flows, user journeys, wireframes, visual design mock-ups and prototypes as needed to effectively conceptualise and communicate detailed interaction behaviours
Work across the entire product lifecycle from concept to delivery; creating documentation, wireframes, hi- & lo-fi prototypes and pixel perfect UI.
Collaborate with engineering & product management to build experiences and present your work to stakeholders
Collaborate on research alongside UX researchers, and conduct usability studies.
Collaborate and communicate with product management to build your design roadmap and manage timelines.
What will you bring to the table?
3-5 years of experience in a UX/UI design role.
Ability to execute on projects end-to-end from problem discovery, hi-fidelity designs, and developer handoff.
Experience working in agile/sprint-based environments.
Experience in regard to collaboration/projects with product, research and tech teams.
Ability to use AI tools to supplement existing design skills. You are able to discern good design practices versus AI-generated solutions.
Experience designing UIs for iOS, Android, and responsive web.
Experience working with and contributing to design systems and component libraries.
Experience with unmoderated user testing tools (Maze, usertesting.com)
High fidelity prototyping skills (Figma, etc.)
Comfortable presenting to larger audiences and senior stakeholders.
Experience with workshop facilitation and design sprints.
Ability to take ownership, creatively solve problems, and proactively contribute to the objectives of the business.
At JET, This Is On The Menu
Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment.
Fun, fast-paced and supportive, the JET culture is about movement, growth and about celebrating every aspect of our JETers. Thanks to them we stay one step ahead of the competition.
Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging
No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Just Eat Takeaway.com. We’re committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity of people and thinking, in which all employees feel they truly belong and can bring their most colourful selves to work every day.
What else is cooking?
Want to know more about our JETers, culture or company? Have a look at our career site where you can find people's stories, blogs, podcasts and more JET morsels.
Note
All employees will be asked to sign a Consent for Disclosure of Personal Information in order to complete a background check. Job offers will be conditional upon results that the Company determines to be satisfactory.
This is a hybrid role, requiring 3 days per week in our Toronto or Winnipeg office and 2 days per week working remotely from home.
Are you ready to take your seat? Apply now!

title: Product Designer
description:
TL;DR
We're looking for an AI-native product designer to work directly with the founders and across several brands. We're VC-backed and scaling fast, so this is a great opportunity to join early and grow with the company. If you're a smart, hungry and creative designer looking for real impact (with equity!), this could be a career defining role for you.
About Us
The Wild Ventures is a VC-backed startup that builds ecommerce products and AI services — ranging from a premium home decor brand (Wild Palace) to a B2B AI growth suite (Creator AI, LandingCreator.ai, Alex by Creator) as well as a growth and brand consultancy (thisisthewild.com).
That means one designer touches a lot of surface area: a B2B SaaS onboarding flow in the morning, a wallpaper video campaign in the afternoon.
The role
We are looking for a talented product designer who can own product interfaces and the marketing creative around them. This is deliberately a broad brief, and it only works because you are AI-native. The output we expect from one person is not achievable at traditional agency pace, so we need someone whose default reflex is to come up with the angle and then reach for the model, rather than the traditional manual process.
If you like being the only designer in the room and shipping fast across formats, you will enjoy it. If you want to specialize deeply in one discipline with a large design team around you, this is not the right seat.
You will report directly to the founders and work alongside engineering and ops.
Product design (roughly half your time)
Design end-to-end flows for our AI SaaS products: onboarding, dashboards, editors, billing and upgrade paths, while measuring what works and experimenting using data
Run UX audits and conversion work on the Wild Palace made-to-measure purchase flow
Build and maintain design systems that engineers can implement without hand-holding
Turn rough product direction into wireframes, prototypes and shipped UI
Brand and graphic design
Own and evolve visual identity across the portfolio, from typographically-led SaaS brands to a design-led interiors brand
Creative assets for product sites and agency engagements
Pitch decks, sales collateral, social assets and email design
Video and ad creative
Concept, edit and ship performance creative for platforms like Meta, YouTube, TikTok, AppLovin, Google and LinkedIn
Product demo videos, feature walkthroughs and short-form social video
Work with the growth side on creative testing: multiple angles, hooks and formats per campaign, then iterate on what the numbers say
AI-native production
Use generative tools to produce ad variants, product visuals and video at a volume that manual production cannot match
Build repeatable pipelines rather than one-off outputs: prompt libraries, reusable templates, consistent brand-locked styling across generated assets
Keep evaluating what is new. The tool you use in six months probably does not exist today, and we expect you to be the one telling us about it
You are probably a fit if
You have 2+ years designing digital products, with a portfolio that shows real, shipped interfaces and not just concept work
You can move between SaaS and consumer ecommerce without flattening both into the same house style
You are fluent in the traditional stack (Figma, Canva, CapCut…) and equally at home in generative tools: Higgsfield, Midjourney, Runway, Veo, Nano Banana, ElevenLabs, v0 or whatever has replaced them by the time you read this
You know where AI output is good enough to ship and where it still looks like AI output, and you have the craft to close that gap
You have made ads that ran, and you can talk about what performed and why
You work well with ambiguity and short briefs, and you push back when the brief is wrong
Nice to have
Front-end literacy: enough HTML, CSS and Tailwind to spec accurately or ship small changes yourself
Experience designing for both B2B SaaS and DTC ecommerce
Motion design or 3D product visualisation
Photography or art direction for lifestyle and interiors
What we offer
Direct ownership of design across a multi-company portfolio, with no layers between you and the decision
Real scope to shape how the brands look and how the products work
Equity in a VC-backed startup
How to apply
Send your portfolio and a short note to arvid@thewildventures.com, covering two things: the piece of work you are proudest of, and how AI tools actually sit in your process today. Be specific about the tools and what they replaced. We care far more about the portfolio than the CV.
Apply now

title: Product Designer
description:
About Programa
Programa is trusted by thousands of architects and interior designers in more than 90 countries. Our vertical SaaS platform helps designers run their business and projects more efficiently and brings their projects, processes, products and purchasing together in one place.
Position Overview
We're looking for a mid-level Product Designer who's as comfortable in a design file as they are shipping code. This is a hands-on role with real ownership, working closely with Product and Engineering from discovery through to delivery. The Product Designer is responsible for designing end-to-end product experiences with a strong focus on user interface (UI) design. The role works closely with the Engineering, Product, and Customer Experience teams to deliver high-quality features. The position requires balancing fast-paced delivery with attention to visual detail and usability, supporting a platform used by professional interior designers.
Designers in this role are required to go beyond design files; using Claude Code to independently ship quality of life improvements directly, closing the loop between design intent and real product impact. The entire product journey, from discovery through to delivery, is a seamless, collaborative effort across Design, Product, and Engineering.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the design of large product features end-to-end, from early concepts and wireframes through to thoughtful UX flows that guide users to the right path, and polished UI ready for engineering.
Work collaboratively with Engineers and Product Managers across the full product journey, from shaping and prioritisation through to build, review, and iteration, ensuring a seamless and unified process end-to-end.
Use Claude Code to independently ship quality of life improvements, enabling designers to move fast, close feedback loops, and take direct ownership of smaller but impactful product changes.
Leverage AI tools to accelerate design and delivery workflows, including partnering with Engineering to create and maintain relevant commands and AI workflows that enforce design system usage, so every product update stays consistent by default, not by manual review.
Help shape how product features are defined, validated, and prioritised, contributing to strategic product decisions as a core voice alongside Product and Engineering.
Contribute to structuring and evolving the design process while remaining comfortable with ambiguity and a fluid environment.
Ensure visual consistency, usability, and alignment with business goals across all design deliverables.
Support the development and maintenance of design systems and reusable components. • Conduct validation activities such as stakeholder reviews and lightweight research.
What we're looking for
3-5+ years of experience in SaaS product design, with a strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end UI work
Exceptional UI craft; you care deeply about visual detail, consistency, and usability
Experience shipping in fast-paced product teams alongside engineers and PMs, with a curiosity about the intersection of design and code, and an eagerness to grow in that space
An openness to working closer to code than most design roles; this is a space we're growing into together, and we'll support you along the way
Experience with design systems and component-based design
A curiosity about how AI tools can change the way designers work; you don't need experience here, just an open mind
Strong communication skills and the ability to contribute to product decisions, not just execute on them
Comfortable with ambiguity and a fluid, evolving process
Bonus Experience
Experience designing for professional workflow-heavy products
Salary & Benefits
Competitive salary & ESOP
Flexible, hybrid work environment
Beautiful office in Richmond
Report directly to the Head of Design and work closely with the CEO and leadership.
A note about what happens after your submit your application
Every application is personally reviewed by a member of our team, no automated filtering here. We take the time to genuinely consider each candidate. We'll only be in touch with applicants whose experience and skills closely match what we're looking for at this stage. If you don't hear from us within 3 weeks, please take this as confirmation that we won't be moving forward with your application this time around.

title: Product Designer
description:
Role Description
In this role, you’ll be the customer's voice as you collaborate with Engineering, Product, Experience Research, Data Science, and business partners to build compelling products. You will solve problems with cross functional partners in collaborative teams, that enable designers to do their best work. As part of a product-driven and design-led company, you'll play a key role in a team of Product Designers owning core product development from inception to iteration and post-launch reflection. If you’re looking for scope, influence and the opportunity to do high-quality work in your next role, this is it.
This role is based in our Vancouver office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.
About The Design Team
We design the future of teamwork.
Asana has a bold, ambitious mission: help humanity thrive by enabling the world’s teams to work together effortlessly. Our design team is at the heart of that mission.
Asana Design is an inclusive and collaborative community. We’re a diverse group of designers from different backgrounds
(product, brand and content design, design operations, producers, motion design, film, copywriting)
. We are a team that loves combining research, data insights, and peer feedback into a human-centered design process to produce designs that are core to the power of our applications. We partner with people across Asana to create our product, shape our brand, and drive greater impact through design. We use design to solve challenges and create experiences that customers love. We also take the time to get weird and have fun along the way.
We believe every designer should have the opportunity to grow and learn by utilizing their strengths and nurturing their interests.
Learn more about our team
Asana Design
Asana Design Medium
Asana Design Instagram
Asana Dribbble
Asana culture
Diversity, Inclusion, & Belonging
How we’ve designed a culture that fuels our business results
How I advanced my career through AsanaUP
How we use (and don’t use) job titles at Asana
About You
3+ years of experience in product design, with a portfolio that demonstrates strong thinking, craft, and iteration across onboarding, growth, or AI-powered product experiences.
Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.
Strong prototyping skills and a maker mindset. You use prototypes regularly to explore ideas, test concepts, and drive collaboration.
Excited by highly collaborative product development and comfortable working closely with PMs and engineers throughout ideation and iteration.
Comfortable navigating ambiguity, moving quickly, and balancing incremental optimization work with longer-term product exploration.
Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with the ability to create polished, intuitive, and high-quality product experiences across every stage of the user journey.
What You’ll Achieve
Lead the design of end-to-end experiences for Asana products and features, with an emphasis on features for billing owners.
Collaborate with cross-functional partners to identify customer problems, establish vision, set strategy, build and ship solutions.
Champion product excellence. Elevate the quality bar for our experience and shape our payment design system.
Work across the organization to ship experiences that are cohesive with the broader Asana product experience, ensuring your design scales.
Facilitate and role model human-centered problem solving. Foster co-creation across the organization.
Learn new methods to solve deeply complex problems in the service of inventing new ways to deliver our customer benefits: flow, efficiency, engagement, and retention.
Help shape a product that is intuitive and elegant, which speaks from a unified voice.
What We’ll Offer
Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.
For this role, the estimated base salary range is between $125,000 - $139,000 CAD. The actual base salary will vary based on factors such as market data and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.
In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include equity and benefits. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.
We strive to provide equitable and competitive benefits packages that support our employees worldwide. Some of these benefits include:
Mental health, wellness & fitness benefits
Career coaching & support
Inclusive family building benefits
Long-term savings or retirement plans
In-office culinary options to cater to your dietary preferences
About Us
Asana is a leading platform for human + AI collaboration. Millions of teams around the world rely on Asana to achieve their most important goals, faster. Asana has been named to Fortune's Best Workplaces for 7+ years and recognized by Fast Company, Forbes, and Gartner for excellence in workplace culture and innovation. We offer an exceptional office-centric culture while adopting the best elements of hybrid models to ensure that every one of our global team members can work together effortlessly. With 13+ offices all over the world, we are always looking for individuals who care about building technology that drives positive change in the world and a culture where everyone feels that they belong.
We believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive. Our goal is to ensure that Asana upholds an environment where all people feel that they are respected and valued, whether they are applying for an open position or working at the company. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Product Designer (Mid-Level)
description:
Hey there! Thanks for stopping by. We're Airtasker, the tech company that connects people who need to get things done with those who have the skills to do it. Our mission is to empower people to realise the full value of their skills. This doesn't just apply to those who use our product. It's also for our whole team of go-getters who bring the product to life and deliver impact to our community on a daily basis. Because we believe work (and life) is always better when you truly know and appreciate your strengths and skills.
We're on the hunt for a
mid-level Product Designer
who's hands-on, AI-curious, and wired for shipping. You'll join a cross-functional team to elevate the customer experience across our product, owning problem spaces from start to finish. Some days that means building the solution yourself to move fast and learn. Other days it means crafting considered designs for engineers to build when the work is more complex.
We move quickly, so this role suits someone who's resourceful inside real constraints, treats prototypes as the fastest way to learn, and has the curiosity to use AI in both the product we ship and the way they work. You'll think holistically about the product (not just the design), form views on what we're shipping and why, and bring them to the table.
You'll have a support network of product designers, product managers, your design manager and engineers to help you grow in your craft and your career, delivering work you're genuinely proud of.
Join our team and help shape the future of Airtasker!
What You'll Do
Own problem spaces end-to-end. Coordinate with PMs, engineers and product marketing to define the work, then carry it from research through to shipped solutions.
Bring a product mindset. Care about what we're shipping and why, not just how it looks, and form views on roadmap, scope, success metrics and trade-offs.
Build, ship, learn. Get something tangible in front of real users early, whether a rough prototype or a thin slice of the live product, and let what you learn drive the next iteration.
Discover creative solutions inside real constraints. Time, scope, resourcing and tech debt are part of the job, so find creative paths to deliver high-quality work at pace.
Look for AI opportunities in our product and your own work. Spot ways AI can help our users in their daily lives, and adopt AI in your own design process to ship faster and explore more.
Rapidly prototype with AI. Move from flows and wireframes through to high-fidelity designs and AI-built front-end prototypes. No coding background needed, just the curiosity to use AI to get there.
Develop and iterate on interfaces with the right level of craft, balancing pragmatism with quality.
Run user research and validate hypotheses to deeply understand problems and shape what comes next.
Apply and contribute to the Airtasker Design System, raising the bar with your own work and feeding improvements back where it makes sense.
Bring your work to the team for feedback, and use design reviews to land on the right solution and execution.
We'd love to hear from you if you tick some of these boxes:
4-5 years of experience in product design.
A hands-on mindset and a real desire to use AI, both in the product you ship and in how you work day-to-day.
Solid foundation in product design fundamentals, with a portfolio that shows growth in visual interface design.
Effective cross-functional collaboration with PMs, engineers, product marketing and others.
Comfortable shipping high-quality work inside real constraints.
Proficient in Figma and comfortable designing for iOS, Android and responsive web.
Proficient in qualitative research, from discovery and prototyping to testing and iteration.
Cares about outcomes, not just outputs, and forms views on the product, not just the design.
Familiarity with marketplace dynamics is helpful, but not required.
Open to giving and receiving constructive feedback in design reviews.
Our People Experience
Our people team at Airtasker are dedicated to designing an industry leading people experience. This means creating an environment where you are empowered to do your best work and realise the full potential of your skills.
Thriving
Hybrid working - when it comes to working, there’s no “one size fits all” approach, with Airtasker you choose the environment that helps you do your best work.
Airtime - welcome to no Slack and meeting-free Fridays! Airtime is designed so we regularly have dedicated focus time for work and personal growth.
Recharge days - each quarter we have a company-wide Recharge Day, equivalent to 4 additional days of leave per year. It’s a day for everyone when the world can wait and self-care takes centre stage.
Wellbeing support - our Employee Assistance Program provides confidential access for our people to GPs, dieticians, counselling and mental health specialists, providing essential support whenever needed.
Airpowerment Fund - we provide a $200 allowance to spend on anything that supports your health & wellbeing
Rewarding
Airtasker credits - it’s a great feeling to get things done. Even greater when you get $1000 worth of credits every year to help you check off your to-do list and connect with our community of Taskers.
Fair and equitable pay - this is a core commitment to our people. Every year we review industry data to ensure our compensation framework supports everyone to be recognised for the full value of their skills.
Tenure leave - To celebrate our people’s commitment to Airtasker, we offer tenure leave starting from your 3rd anniversary with the company. This begins with 3 extra days of leave per year, gradually increasing to a maximum of 5 days per year.
Belonging
DAREtasker - join our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion committee! Every month we meet to create meaningful and impactful programs of work that embrace belonging at Airtasker.
Celebration swap - not everyone celebrates the same things. That’s why, at Airtasker, you can swap national, state or territory public holidays for the ones that matter to you.
Growing
Learning and development - learning at Airtasker is on the job, guided by managers, enhanced by peers and led by ourselves. We deliver learning programs and budget allowances to invest in your growth.
360 performance reviews - feedback is a gift. Every year we run 360 reviews across the business to recognise achievements and promote personal growth.
Volunteer leave - Our team members can take a day each year to lend a helping hand and support a cause they are passionate about.
Celebrating
Awards - and the winners are… our go-getters! Whether it’s our peer-nominated quarterly Values Awards or our periodic Go-Getter Spirit Award, we love celebrating our people and spreading good energy.
Vibe committee - good vibes only! Our Vibe Committee delivers events that hit the sweet spot of bringing us all together to enjoy each other’s company whether you’re local or remote.
Birthday leave - All of our people get an extra day of leave during their birthday week to take time away from work to celebrate.
At Airtasker we believe in culture add - that each person is different and has their own background, learnings and unique experiences that can add to the Airtasker cultural tapestry. We pride ourselves on our inclusive culture, and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds.
To all recruitment agencies and talent suppliers: Airtasker does not accept unsolicited resumes. Airtasker is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
