title: Consumer Insights Specialist
description:
About the Company
CHANGAN Automobile is one of the four major Chinese automobile groups, boasting a heritage spanning 164 years and 41 years of car manufacturing experience. We have 14 manufacturing bases and 39 plants worldwide. As a leading Chinese car manufacturer, CHANGAN Automobile has self-owned brands including CHANGAN UNI, CHANGAN NEVO, CHANGAN LCV, DEEPAL, and AVATR, and joint venture brands including CHANGAN Ford, CHANGAN Mazda, and JMC. User research for key markets in the region, focusing on new car users.

title: Associate, Consumer Insights
description:
Application deadline 10 August 2026
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
You’ll join our Research and Design experts within the
AI, Insights & Solutions
team.

In this multidisciplinary environment, you'll leverage deep research expertise with business acumen to help clients tackle their most transformative challenges. You’ll work on integrated teams alongside our general consultants and clients to develop data-driven strategies and innovative solutions. Together, we create human-centric solutions that harness the power of data and artificial intelligence to drive competitive advantage for our clients. Our collaborative and supportive work environment fosters creativity and continuous learning, enabling us to consistently deliver exceptional results.
WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM
As a Associate Primary Researcher you will work closely with Bain project teams – across strategy, value proposition design, customer experience – as well as the Private Equity Group and clients. You’ll design and deliver high-quality primary research, combining quantitative and qualitative approaches to generate actionable insights that shape critical business decisions.
You’ll also be part of a team dedicated to evolving our primary research capabilities, helping redefine how we generate insights through innovative approaches – including the use of human-AI collaboration to deliver faster, deeper, and more actionable results.
WHAT YOU’LL DO
Provide primary market research and user research expertise to Bain case teams and clients globally, although with more focus on Europe and the Middle East. As an Associate, Primary Research, you will support the full end-to-end research process – from designing the right approach (qualitative, quantitative or mixed methods), data collection and insight synthesis. Your work will translate research findings into clear, actionable insights that directly inform strategic recommendations and drive business impact.
Apply a range of research methods and analytical techniques to address key business questions – such as customer implications for strategy, customer acquisition and retention, new product development and pricing, customer experience design and engagement,  brand strategy and messaging, go-to-market strategy, among others.
Train and coach AIS colleagues and consultants on primary research procedures.
Take ownership of the end-to-end research to insight process – from defining the research approach to delivering actionable insights.
Stay at the forefront of emerging and cutting-edge research methodologies and tools
Develop relationships with external research vendors and interact with as needed at the project level
Codify, document and share best practice experience with Bain’s consulting team to enhance the value of primary research / user research
Leverage AI-enabled research tools and workflows to enhance research design, data synthesis, insight generation, and scalability of primary research delivery
ABOUT YOU
1-2 years of experience with primary market research or user research experience in a business, market research or social science environment
Master’s Degree or PhD in market research, sociology, ethnography or related field is a plus
Expertise in quantitative research methodologies, knowledgeable with qualitative research methodologies
Experience in using statistics to analyze quantitative research data such as significant test, sample reweighting, regression and clustering, segmentation, conjoint analysis etc.
Champion the voice of customer / user
Strong interpersonal, communication and storytelling skills
Must thrive in a fast paced environment and be able to work independently
Fluency in English is required, along with business-level proficiency in the local language of the office location.
Interest or experience in applying AI-enabled tools, automation, or generative AI technologies within research, insights, or analytics workflows

Proactive, self-driven, and capable of working across teams to drive cross-functional alignment.
Strong organizational and time management abilities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

title: Project Associate
description:
The Mission
Dubai Design Lab is an action lab under the Dubai Future Foundation, harnessing the power of design and creativity to position Dubai among the world’s most livable cities. The lab (re)designs, prototypes, and tests policies, strategies, and systems aligned with Dubai’s vision ; creating a platform where individuals and organizations come together to imagine and shape a better future. By combining experimentation, collaboration, and human-centered design, the lab drives innovation and contributes to Dubai’s growth as a leading global hub.
Overview
Dubai Design Lab, an action lab within the Dubai Future Foundation, is seeking a Project Associate to serve as a sector-agnostic analyst across its portfolio of projects. Operating as part of the Dubai Design Lab, the Project Associate works in the manner of a management consultant — deployed flexibly across projects, sectors, and problem types, and responsible for the research, analysis, and synthesis that underpin the Lab’s work.
The role suits an early-career professional who thinks in a structured, hypothesis-driven way and is equally comfortable conducting a benchmarking exercise, facilitating a research circle, analysing data, and translating findings into clear, decision-ready insight. You will bring a rigorous consulting toolkit to whatever a project requires — from desk research and primary fieldwork through to quantitative analysis and executive-ready deliverables — and will adapt quickly to unfamiliar subject matter as you move between engagements.
Key Responsibilities
Research and Benchmarking
○ Conduct desk and secondary research across sectors, industries, and themes, developing a working command of unfamiliar subject matter at pace.
○ Design and deliver benchmarking, landscape, and comparative analyses, identifying relevant comparators, best practices, and reference points.
○ Gather, organise, and quality-assure evidence from a wide range of sources to establish a sound factual basis for each project.
Primary Research and Fieldwork
○ Plan and conduct interviews, contextual conversations, and stakeholder engagements to gather first-hand insight.
○ Design and facilitate research circles, focus groups, and workshops that surface user and stakeholder perspectives.
○ Support the design and administration of surveys and other primary-research instruments, capturing both qualitative and quantitative signal from the field.
Analysis, Personas and Use-Case Development
○ Undertake structured analysis of qualitative and quantitative data, decomposing complex problems into clear, testable components.
○ Perform quantitative analysis as required — cleaning, structuring, and interrogating data, and building models to quantify options and trade-offs.
○ Develop personas, user segments, and use cases grounded in research evidence, translating behavioural and market findings into actionable profiles that inform design and strategy.
○ Apply analytical rigour throughout, ensuring conclusions are evidence-based rather than assumed.
Synthesis and Insight Development
○ Synthesise qualitative and quantitative findings into clear insights, patterns, and implications.
○ Develop insight frameworks, opportunity areas, and hypotheses that translate evidence into strategic direction.
○ Distil complexity into structured, compelling narratives that leadership and project teams can act upon.
Deliverables and Project Support
○ Produce executive-ready deliverables — memoranda, briefings, and well-structured presentations that communicate a clear and persuasive narrative.
○ Support project leads with day-to-day delivery, including workplanning, task tracking, and maintaining momentum across workstreams.
○ Work flexibly across multiple projects and teams, adapting readily to new sectors, problems, and ways of working.
Who We're Looking For?
Qualifications
○ Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Finance, Social Sciences, Design, or a related discipline; a relevant master’s degree is an advantage.
○ 1–2 years of experience in management consulting, strategy, research, design, or a comparable analytical role.
Skills and Competencies
○ Intellectual curiosity and adaptability, with the ability to develop command of any subject matter quickly and to work across markedly different problems.
○ Exceptional structured problem-solving, with the ability to break ambiguous challenges into clear hypotheses and workplans.
○ Strong research capability across both secondary methods (desk research, benchmarking) and primary methods (interviews, research circles, surveys).
○ Sound analytical and quantitative ability, comfortable working with data and building models and analyses in Excel.
○ Strong synthesis skills, able to convert qualitative and quantitative inputs into clear insight, personas, use cases, and frameworks.
○ Excellent PowerPoint and Excel skills, with the ability to produce clear, well-structured, and compelling deliverables; familiarity with business-intelligence or data-visualisation tools is an advantage.
○ Outstanding written and verbal communication, with the ability to construct a clear and persuasive narrative from analysis.
○ Ability to work natively with AI tools and emerging technologies to accelerate research, analysis, and synthesis.
○ Comfort with ambiguity and a strong bias for action, together with a collaborative approach across diverse teams, cultures, and seniority levels.

Here's a Summary Of The Role
Ever looked at a client's data and known there was a much bigger story in there than the brief asked for? We want you to go find it and then help the client see it too.
We're looking for a Research Manager to design and deliver quantitative market research for clients across the region, and to turn what you learn into real commercial opportunity. You'll run projects end-to-end — questionnaire design, fieldwork, analysis, and reporting — and you'll be just as comfortable spotting the client's next need as you are presenting the results. You'll bring genuine curiosity about AI and automation into your everyday work, and you'll present findings as a story, not a slide-by-slide walk through the data.
Here's a breakdown of what you'll do (not all of it, just the important stuff):
Design and deliver research projects for regional and global clients, from questionnaire through to results.
Work-flow planning, organizing and troubleshooting issues with support teams – including scripting, fieldwork, data processing and finance
Turn data into a story your clients remember and act on — not just a stack of charts and trend lines.
Spot the next opportunity in every account and help turn insight into more work for the team.
Bring AI and automation into your everyday toolkit, speeding up everything from questionnaire checks to first-draft analysis.
Build genuine, trusted relationships with clients across a range of industries.
Work closely with a talented regional team of researchers and account managers.

5+ years' quantitative market research experience, including direct client management.

title: Senior Research Manager
description:
Function:
Senior Research Manager and client servicing
Department:
Data Services – MENA
Location:
Dubai, UAE
Working Arrangement Type:
Full-time, Permanent, Hybrid (Minimum 3 days in office – subject to review)
Line Manager:
Director, Data Services
Here's a Summary Of The Role
Ever wanted to be the person your biggest clients call first, not the analyst they email later? This role is built for someone who wants to own that relationship.
We're looking for a Senior Research Manager to own some of our most complex and high-value client relationships across the region. You'll lead quantitative research end-to-end, but the real value you'll bring is what happens next, spotting the next opportunity, expanding what clients get from working with us, and presenting findings as a compelling story rather than a read-through of the data. You'll also help set the standard for the team around you: championing AI-enabled ways of working and mentoring more junior colleagues on both the craft and the client-facing side of the job.
Here's a breakdown of what you'll do (not all of it, just the important stuff):
Own and grow some of our most complex or high-value client relationships across the region.
Turn data into a story senior stakeholders remember and act on — not a slide-by-slide read-out.
Actively expand what clients get from working with us, spotting the next opportunity in every account.
Champion AI and automation across the team's ways of working, not just your own.
Mentor and develop junior researchers and help shape how the team works day to day.
Lead complex or sensitive client enquiries end-to-end, from Proposal through to delivery including include questionnaire development, coordinating translations, testing survey links, survey setup, monitoring fieldwork (both online and offline), data processing and reporting and next opportunity suggestion
These are the essentials you'll need to get an interview:
7-8+ years' quantitative market research experience, including sustained client management and team leadership.
Proficiency in managing face-to-face and online data collection processes specific to quantitative research.
Experience with statistical analysis or data weighting.
A track record of growing accounts, not just delivering projects; you think commercially by instinct.
Confidence leading a room; you tell a story with data; you don't just read out a chart.
Genuine curiosity about AI tools, and comfortable championing them with others.
Strong analytical, organisational, and problem-solving skills.
Strong ability to work on multiple projects at different stages simultaneously whilst meeting deadlines and being the day-to-day point of contact for your clients
Fluent in English and Arabic.
Comfortable working across different cultural contexts within the MENA region.
It would be great if you had these too, but we'll support you if you don't:
Commercial acumen with an understanding of how upselling and growing accounts leads to regional commercial success
Hands-on experience using AI or automation tools in a research or analytics context.
Experience of mentoring junior team members.
Here's a Bit About Us
YouGov is a global online research company, offering insight into what the world thinks.
We speak daily to our panel of over 24 million registered members to understand opinion and behaviours around the world. We have a strong reputation as a source of accurate data and we're trusted by the world's biggest brands to get it right, making us the most quoted market research source in the world.

Why join YouGov?
Join our global team to help us achieve our social mission: to make millions of people's opinions heard for the benefit of our local, national, and international communities.

If our research is to be truly representative of what the world thinks, we need people from all walks of life to be part of the team to bring their perspective to the work we do.
Life at YouGov
We are driven by a set of shared values. We are fast, fearless, and innovative. We work diligently to get it right. We are guided by accuracy, ethics, and proven methodologies. We respect and trust each other, bringing these values into everything that we do.

title: Junior Market Analyst - UAE National
description:
About The Job
Richemont is seeking a highly motivated and analytical Junior Market Analyst to join our dynamic team in the MEIAT region. Reporting directly to the Business Development Analyst MEIAT, you will conduct local field and market research to gather competitive intelligence, analyze internal data, and help shape regional strategies.
This is a unique opportunity to provide key market insights to Richemont and its iconic Maisons across the Middle East, India, Africa, and Türkiye. You will be instrumental in mapping competitor distribution networks, identifying untapped market opportunities ("white spots"), and supporting short-, mid-, and long-term strategic planning for regional leadership.
Key Responsibilities
Market Intelligence & Insights: Conduct proactive research on market health, tourism, and real estate dynamics to deliver actionable market intelligence reports and high-quality strategic presentations.
Strategic Outlook & Support: Analyze market and competitor data to uncover new business opportunities, helping individual Maisons prioritize and align their regional growth strategies.
Distribution & Competitor Mapping: Support the development of analytical tools to track the evolution of competitors’ retail networks and identify untapped distribution opportunities in the region.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with the Real Estate department and individual Maisons to capture local network data and successfully roll out regional tracking tools.
Knowledge Sharing & Communication: Publish competitor activity reports during key regional cultural events (e.g., Ramadan, Diwali) and manage the department’s SharePoint platform to ensure seamless information sharing.
Skills
Analytical Mindset: Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and data visualization/BI tools (such as Looker or similar platforms), with strong data interpretation skills and meticulous attention to detail.
Design & Presentation: Exceptional PowerPoint skills with a strong eye for visual design, typography, and clean data visualization to present insights clearly to diverse stakeholders.
Languages: Fluency in written and verbal English is mandatory; command of Arabic and/or French is a major plus.
Experience: Prior exposure to the luxury retail industry or a strong understanding of the MEIAT region’s cultural and economic landscape is preferred.
Mindset & Attitude: Highly detail-oriented and collaborative, with a strong drive to learn, grow, and a deep passion for market intelligence and the luxury sector.
Why Richemont?
Join a global leader in luxury, where your research and insights will directly support the regional expansion and strategic direction of iconic Maisons. This role offers an exceptional entry point into luxury retail, offering high-visibility learning opportunities, cross-departmental collaboration, and a platform to grow your career within a prestigious international environment.

title: Product Designer
description:
A Little Bit About Talabat
talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world's pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in over 70+ countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.
Job Description
As part of the Delivery Hero network, talabat is the pioneer of the online food ordering industry in the Middle East. We're on a mission to become one of the most "Experience-first" companies in the region, and we're looking for a Product Designer to grow with us.
We're looking for someone who is curious, hungry to learn, and excited to work on real products that touch millions of lives every day. You'll work closely with senior designers, product managers, and engineers to help ship thoughtful, user-centered experiences. You'll have support, but also real ownership, because we believe the best way to grow is by doing.
If you're someone who takes pride in the details, welcomes feedback, and cares deeply about the people using the products you build, we'd love to meet you.
Job Description
What's On Your Plate?
Build familiarity with your squad's product area and users, with guidance from your manager and senior designer.
Translate well-defined problems into clean, considered design solutions, wireframes, flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity visuals.
Participate in generative and evaluative research activities (user interviews, usability tests) alongside more senior team members.
Work within and apply the design system consistently across your features; flag gaps or inconsistencies when you spot them.
Gather and incorporate feedback from users, peers, and stakeholders throughout the design process.
Partner with your PM and senior designer to understand the problem space before jumping to solutions.
Share your work regularly with your immediate team for early feedback and iteration.
Participate in cross-functional workshops and design critique sessions as a contributor.
Document your design decisions and rationale clearly for handoff and async review.
Stay curious. Continuously develop your craft through feedback, peer learning, and industry awareness.
Explore AI tools as part of your design process and stay curious about how they can raise the quality and speed of your work.
Qualifications
What Did We Order?
Preferably a Bachelor's Degree in Fine Arts, Design, Visual Communication, HCI, or a related field.
1–2 years of full-time UX/UI design experience, ideally in a consumer-facing product environment.
A portfolio that demonstrates your design thinking process, not just polished outputs, but how you approached and solved problems.
Working knowledge of design and prototyping tools (Figma preferred; AI tools, etc)
Familiarity with core UX methods (e.g., user flows, journey mapping, wireframing, basic usability testing).
An eye for detail and a genuine care for how things look, feel, and function.
Comfortable asking questions, receiving direct feedback, and iterating quickly.
Clear communicator who can explain their design choices to their immediate team.
Organized and able to manage their own tasks in an agile sprint environment with guidance.
Humble and growth-minded, you see every critique as a chance to get better.

title: UX Lead
description:
About Holo:
At Holo, we’re on a mission to simplify homeownership through technology, expert guidance, and transparency. We operate across three core entities:
Holo Mortgage – providing digital mortgage solutions tailored to each client
Holo Concierge – our concierge-style service that partners with clients and real estate agents to help approved buyers find their dream home.
Holo KSA – expanding our footprint and innovation into the Saudi market
With over 25 years of expertise and 24,000+ happy homeowners, we’ve mastered the art of simplifying the homebuying journey. We’re building a smarter, faster, and more accessible way to own a home.
The Role
We’re looking for a UX & Product Design Lead to raise the bar on product quality across Holo. As we expand across Mortgage, Concierge, Conveyancing, Finance, and Partner platforms, our product surface area is growing quickly. We need someone who can bring cohesion, clarity, and strong design principles across everything we build. You’ll lead and grow the design function while remaining hands-on with high-impact work. This means shaping complex workflows, refining service experiences, evolving our design system, and embedding strong UX thinking into discovery and delivery. This role sits at the intersection of craft and leadership. You’ll define what “good” looks like at Holo, ensure we build to that standard consistently, and help Product and Engineering make better experience decisions every day.
If you care deeply about quality, simplicity, and building systems that scale thoughtfully, this role will give you real ownership to do that.
What You’ll Own
Define and implement Holo’s UX principles and design standards across all product surfaces
Own the evolution and governance of Holo’s design system
Design high-impact, complex workflows across critical user experiences
Elevate service experience across the full lifecycle - not just individual screens
Partner closely with Product and Engineering to ensure strong discovery, usability validation, and delivery quality
Introduce structured user research and usability testing practices
Reduce design sprawl and ensure consistency across web, internal tools, and mobile surfaces
Establish scalable processes for design reviews, critique, and documentation
What We’re Looking For
6+ years of experience in Product Design, with experience leading or mentoring other designers
Proven ability to raise the quality bar and establish strong design standards across teams
Strong end-to-end UX craft across research, interaction design, visual design, and systems thinking
Experience designing complex internal tools or operational systems
Ability to think beyond screens - designing service experience across the full customer lifecycle
Strong systems thinker who can reduce complexity without oversimplifying
Experience building and maintaining scalable design systems
Comfortable balancing hands-on design work with team leadership and hiring
Excellent communicator who can articulate design decisions clearly to Product and Engineering
Thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments with high ownership
Bonus
Experience in fintech, proptech, marketplaces, or high-consideration transactions
Experience designing for bilingual markets (EN/AR)
Exposure to user research frameworks and structured usability testing
Experience scaling a design team from early stage to growth
Why This Role Matters
Holo is growing quickly across markets, teams, and product surfaces. As that complexity increases, design quality becomes harder to maintain - and more critical to get right. We’re building tools that power revenue internally and experiences that build trust externally. If the experience becomes inconsistent, cluttered, or overly complex, it slows teams down and chips away at customer confidence. We need someone who can bring clarity, cohesion, and strong standards across everything we ship. This role ensures our product experience scales thoughtfully - not accidentally - as the company grows.
Benefits:
Competitive salary
Health insurance and other benefits
25 days annual leave plus National Holidays
Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Leave
Opportunities for career growth and development in a dynamic environment
A supportive and collaborative team environment.
Half day Fridays, finishing at 1pm - giving you a well deserved early start to the weekend!
We are committed to equal employment opportunities and we want to ensure that our recruitment process is accessible to everyone. If you have a disability or additional need that requires reasonable accommodations during the process please do not hesitate to let us know. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability status.

At Toluna, we keep the world’s biggest brands one step ahead of their markets, their competitors, and their customers. For 25+ years we’ve been a leader in consumer insights, and today we’re at the center of our industry’s biggest shift: the move to AI-powered research grounded in real human truth.
Brands come to us because we’ve solved a problem most of our industry is still wrestling with: how to move fast without losing trust in the answer. Speed comes from AI we’ve been developing in-house since 2019, always-on platforms, and a 79M+ validated consumer community across 100+ countries.

We are on the lookout right now, for the most dynamic and talented researchers in the industry.

description:
Full Time Position at American University of Sharjah:
Her Highness Sheikha Jawaher Bint Mohammed Al Qasimi Endowed Chair in Women’s Leadership
Post date:
October 8, 2025
Application deadline
: February 8, 2026
American University of Sharjah invites applicants for a full-time faculty position at the rank of Professor who will also serve as Her Highness Sheikha Jawaher Bint Mohammed Al Qasimi Endowed Chair in Women’s Leadership. The successful candidate is expected to promote interdisciplinary research, innovative teaching and community engagement in women's leadership, advancing understanding of leadership dynamics, gender equity and empowerment. Priority will be given to distinguished scholars with a significant body of work addressing challenges, practices and strategies in women’s leadership across sectors. The Endowed Chair will play a key role in advancing the university mission to foster an inclusive environment, advocating for women’s empowerment and social equity. The selected candidate will be appointed to a full-time, rolling-track faculty position within an academic department that aligns with their area of expertise
Job Qualifications
The Endowed Chair in Women’s Leadership is expected to have a PhD (or terminal degree) in one of the disciplines represented in the four colleges/school at AUS; a distinguished record of outstanding intellectual contributions in research and education in Women's Leadership, evidenced by high scholarly productivity and impact; excellence in teaching; proven leadership capability; and familiarity with the cultural context of the region. A successful candidate is expected to contribute to the curriculum at the undergraduate, graduate, post-graduate and/or professional levels.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct and publish original research with an explicit focus on women’s leadership and advancement, women in multicultural and complex societies, or social justice and women’s advancement in the UAE and Gulf.
Build intellectual community and provide leadership through outreach activities that bring the community in direct contact with scholarly experts, including public discussions, workshops and symposiums.
Create and help deliver innovative leadership programs that enable women to benefit from the latest leadership insights for the development of personal strategies that build confidence, influence and resilience.
Advocate for women's issues and gender equity within the academic community.

title: Student Experience Lead
description:
About Noon
Radically Changing the Way People Learn!
Noon Academy
is the leading edtech platform in the Middle East, with over 12 million students and teachers using our app to learn, teach, and collaborate. We have recently raised $41 million in Series B funding to expand our reach and impact in the region and beyond. We are on a mission to transform the physical classroom experience by introducing our highly engaging social, group-based learning and AI to make learning fun and improve learning efficacy. Our ultimate goal is to provide access to the best teachers to every student even if that teacher is only available virtually. We believe we can do this if we blend AI, peer-to-peer learning, and a carefully designed physical space.
Hear it directly from our CEO and co-founder:
this
Learn more about us:
here
Now: We’re laser-focused on reinventing schools in Saudi Arabia. We’re accelerating rapidly, well-funded, and profitable.
Office: Full-time, Riyadh-based. We’ve got a sweet office near the Boulevard, and we’d love to have you in it.
Student Journey Lead
Role purpose
The student journey is the backbone of everything the Noon team does — and keeping it accurate, principled, and improving is a continuous job. This role exists to support and extend that work: contributing to the design principles that shape how journeys are built, maintaining the journey map across student segments, synthesising what students are telling us into clear problems, and helping coordinate the experiments and moments that make each step feel like a win.
What You'll Do
Contribute to journey design and principles
Help define and document the design principles that guide how student journeys are built — what makes a step clear, motivating, and completable.
Maintain the end-to-end journey map across student segments: grade, level, course, track. Flag where the journey is unclear, too fast, too slow, or missing support.
Coordinate with product, learning, and school operations to make sure the map reflects reality, not just intention.
Support student motivation
Work with the motivation system (rewards, coins, progression signals) as a lever for journey completion — understanding how it's used, where it's working, and where students are dropping off despite it.
Help identify moments in the journey where motivation is low and test whether adjusting the reward logic or design changes behaviour.
Synthesise student feedback (VoC)
Collect and organise student survey results, support inputs, school feedback, and qualitative interview notes on a recurring basis.
Tag and group feedback into consistent themes — so the team is looking at root causes, not a list of individual complaints.
Prepare clear summaries that make it easy to decide what to act on next.
Support journey experiments and signature moments
Help coordinate pilots and tests on new journey ideas: who's involved, what the design is, how we'll know if it worked.
Track outcomes and summarise learnings clearly enough that they stick.
Support the design of key student-facing moments — orientations, exam results, milestone celebrations.
What We're Looking For
2 years of experience in product, or a role where your job was to organise and synthesise information to support better decisions.
Organised and reliable: when you say you'll track something, it gets tracked.
Curious about the "why" behind behaviour — not satisfied knowing that completion dropped; you want to understand where and for whom.
Comfortable being a strong second. You make the people around you more effective.
You'll thrive here if you
Like making sense of things. You're the person who reads the survey comments, not just the averages.
Follow through without being chased. You manage your own work and flag early when something's at risk.
Are eager to learn how journey design works in practice — and want to grow into owning more of it over time.
Noon Academy is the leading edtech platform in the Middle East, with over 14 million students and teachers using our app to learn, teach, and collaborate. We have recently raised $41 million in Series B funding to expand our reach and impact in the region and beyond. We are on a mission to transform the physical classroom experience by introducing our highly engaging social, group-based learning and AI to make learning fun and improve learning efficacy. Our ultimate goal is to provide access to the best teachers to every student even if that teacher is only available virtually. We believe we can do this if we blend AI, peer-to-peer learning, and a carefully designed physical space.

About Scrumconnect
Scrumconnect Ltd is a technology consultancy that partners with organisations to deliver high-quality digital services and products. We specialise in user-centred design, agile delivery, and modern data platforms, helping our clients build solutions that are scalable, accessible, and impactful. Our multidisciplinary teams work collaboratively to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful outcomes through innovative technology and research-driven insights.
Role Overview
We are seeking a User Researcher to support the development and enhancement of a digital platform used by internal policy and analytical teams as well as relevant arm's-length bodies.
The successful candidate will plan and conduct research to understand user needs, evaluate how effectively those needs are currently being met by the platform, and identify opportunities for improvement. The research will help inform future development phases and explore engagement with additional user groups.
Location Requirement
This role requires mandatory travel to Newcastle 3 days per week for on-site collaboration with stakeholders and delivery teams.
Key Responsibilities
Plan and conduct user research activities with internal policy and analytical teams and other relevant stakeholders.
Identify and document user needs, behaviours, and pain points through interviews, workshops, and usability testing.
Assess how current platform capabilities meet the needs of primary users.
Identify gaps, challenges, and opportunities to improve the user experience and platform functionality.
Analyse and synthesise research findings into clear insights and actionable recommendations.
Develop and maintain a research plan to support future phases of platform development.
Explore approaches to engage additional user groups, including organisations within the PropTech ecosystem.
Work closely with product managers, designers, and delivery teams to ensure research findings inform decision-making and product development.
Skills And Experience
Proven experience conducting user research within digital product or service environments.
Strong experience with qualitative research methods, including interviews, usability testing, and workshops.
Ability to analyse research data and translate insights into practical recommendations.
Experience working with multi-disciplinary teams, including product managers, designers, and analysts.
Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills.
Experience working in complex or public sector environments is desirable.
Familiarity with user-centred design principles and best practices.
Deliverables
User research plan and research framework.
Stakeholder and user insight reports.
Identification of gaps and improvement opportunities within the platform.
Recommendations to improve user experience and platform functionality.
Strategy for engaging additional user groups in future phases.
Diversity & Inclusion
At Scrumconnect Ltd, we are committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe diversity strengthens our teams and helps us create better digital services for everyone.

title: UX Researcher
description:
Role Summary
At McAfee, we’re committed to creating secure, intuitive, and delightful experiences for millions of users worldwide. As a UX Researcher, you’ll be at the forefront of shaping product experiences by uncovering insights that drive design and business decisions.
We are looking for a Researcher who is passionate about understanding users and translating insights into impactful experiences. You will bring a mix of technical expertise, design knowledge, and strong communication skills to the team.
This is a Hybrid position located in either Waterloo or Toronto, Canada. You will be required to be onsite on an as-needed basis, typically 1 to 6 times a month. We are only considering candidates within a commutable distance to one of the two locations and are not offering relocation assistance at this time.
Position Details
About The Role
Collaborate closely with interaction designers, content strategists, product managers, marketers
Plan and conduct lightweight prototype testing to evaluate design assumptions and reduce risk prior to development.
Apply statistical methods to interpret research findings and ensure reliability and significance.
Support customer experience measurement programs, including survey execution, data quality monitoring, and longitudinal reporting
Work with researchers, analysts, and data scientists to triangulate findings across data sources
Design and execute light qualitative studies (e.g., interviews, usability tests) to complement quantitative findings.
Translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations that influence product design.
About You
4+ years of proven experience in UX research within software or digital product environments.
Proficiency in inferential statistics and ability to structure controlled experiments.
Experience with tools like Excel, R, or Python for running basic analyses.
Experience analyzing user journeys and conversion funnels to identify friction points and optimize engagement.
Strong understanding of UX principles and design heuristics.
Experience conducting top-down qualitative analyses aligned with research objectives.
Familiarity with triangulating findings using multiple data sources
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
Skilled at fostering alignment within your team and stakeholders.
Company Overview
McAfee is a leader in personal security for consumers. Focused on protecting people, not just devices, McAfee consumer solutions adapt to users’ needs in an always online world, empowering them to live securely through integrated, intuitive solutions that protects their families and communities with the right security at the right moment.

We work hard to embrace diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone at McAfee to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family-friendly benefits to all of our employees.

Support for Community Involvement

title: User Experience Researcher
description:
Who we are:
Once For All is a high growth, cloud-based, SaaS subscription business, providing governance, risk management and compliance services to over 4,000 public and private sector clients and over 60,000 customers across 20 different sectors including construction, transport, retail, hospitality education, facility and property management, manufacturing, local and central government.
We manage the qualification, onboarding and audit requirements of individuals, companies, and industry bodies. We provide real-time monitoring and verification of critical data points across all work categories, tenders, and projects. We enable Buyers to access at the touch of a button, data analytics across their entire supply chain in areas such as validity and expiration of specific licenses, qualifications and certificates, accuracy of financial health, insurance levels and exclusions, CSR, infosec and environmental policies and up-to-date health and safety reports.
About the Role:
As UX Researcher, you will join our UX Team, within Product Design and be a fundamental part of the growth of our cloud based SaaS platform.
As a UX researcher, you'll need to:
Conduct primary and secondary user research.
Conduct and evaluate quantitative and qualitative research.
Perform market and ethnographic research.
Work closely with cross-functional teams to identify and evaluate research topics.
be involved in sketching, prototyping with the UX/UI and Engineering teams.
Plan and implement user research strategies and methodologies.
Advocate research findings to diverse audiences through written and oral presentations.
Perform usability studies with internal and external users.
Ask questions, gather, and analyse data.
Use a diverse set of UX research tools.
What you will need:
3 or more years of UX research experience.
Ability to share research results quickly and effectively.
Ability to perform all research-related tasks including research, planning, evaluating, and iteration.
Ability to formulate specific, answerable, and practical questions.
Ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders and act as a strategic partner in product decisions.
Experience with remote testing tools.
Experience using Figma and other prototyping and design tools.
A strong desire for creative problem-solving with a positive attitude.
Excellent time-management skills and self-management.
Experience in B2B SaaS products.
Be willing to occasionally travel to London, Spain & France.

Pension
Life Assurance x 3
25 days holiday plus 8 Bank Holidays
Ongoing continual professional development (CPD)
Holiday purchase Scheme up to 5 days

24/7 and 365 Days Employee Assistance Programme
Team and company offsite events

Free Tea, Coffee and fruit every week – Basingstoke office

title: User Researcher
description:
Methods Business and Digital Technology Limited
Methods is a £100M+ IT Services Consultancy who has partnered with a range of central government departments and agencies to transform the way the public sector operates in the UK. Established over 30 years ago and UK-based, we apply our skills in transformation, delivery, and collaboration from across the Methods Group, to create end-to-end business and technical solutions that are people-centred, safe, and designed for the future.
Our human touch sets us apart from other consultancies, system integrators and software houses - with people, technology, and data at the heart of who we are, we believe in creating value and sustainability through everything we do for our clients, staff, communities, and the planet.
We support our clients in the success of their projects while working collaboratively to share skill sets and solve problems. At Methods we have fun while working hard; we are not afraid of making mistakes and learning from them.

Knowledge, experience and passion for user centered design practices

Confidence developing user needs, personas/mindsets, user journey maps, and other research artefacts
Experience applying and understanding of ethical research practices and processes, such as consent

title: UX Researcher
description:
About The Company
Netomi is the leading agentic AI platform for enterprise customer experience. We work with the largest global brands like Delta Airlines, MetLife, MGM, United, and others to enable agentic automation at scale across the entire customer journey. Our no-code platform delivers the fastest time to market, lowest total cost of ownership, and simple, scalable management of AI agents for any CX use case. Backed by WndrCo, Y Combinator, and Index Ventures, we help enterprises drive efficiency, lower costs, and deliver higher quality customer experiences.
Want to be part of the AI revolution and transform how the world’s largest global brands do business? Join us!
About The Role
You'll be the voice of our users inside Product and Design, running both formative research that shapes what we build and validation research that ensures we built it right. You won't be researching in a vacuum: you'll have direct access to our outbound teams to drive customer conversations, and to our AI implementation teams and Forward Deployed Engineers who live inside customer deployments every day. Few researchers get this close to real enterprise pain points.
Responsibilities
Plan and run formative research (discovery interviews, field studies, jobs-to-be-done analysis) that informs product strategy and roadmap decisions
Run validation research (usability testing, concept testing, beta feedback loops) to pressure-test designs before and after they ship
Partner with outbound and customer-facing teams to recruit participants and drive ongoing customer conversations
Mine insights from AI implementation teams and FDEs, turning frontline deployment pain points into actionable UX improvements
Synthesize findings into clear, prioritized recommendations that Product and Design can act on immediately
Build lightweight, repeatable research practices that scale with the team, including self-serve tools and insight repositories
Champion research rigor while moving at startup speed: right-sized methods, fast turnarounds, no research theater
Requirement
4–7 years of UX research experience, ideally on B2B/enterprise SaaS or technically complex products
Strong command of both qualitative and quantitative methods, and good judgment about which to use when
Experience researching with enterprise users and buyers, not just consumers
Ability to work independently: you scope your own studies, manage your own pipeline, and drive projects end to end
Excellent synthesis and storytelling skills; your readouts change decisions, not just inform them
Comfort with ambiguity and technical depth; curiosity about AI and how enterprises adopt it
Strong collaboration across Product, Design, Engineering, and go-to-market teams
Why This Role
Unmatched access: direct lines to customers, outbound teams, and FDEs embedded in Fortune 500 deployments
Real influence: research here shapes the roadmap of a category-defining platform, not the margins of it
Frontier domain: agentic AI is being defined right now; you'll uncover what enterprises actually need to trust and adopt it
Netomi is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity in the workplace. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: UX Researcher
description:
Who We Are
With its A.I.-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high-density, end-to-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility.
What We Need
We are seeking a talented UX Researcher with a minimum of 2 years of industry experience. The candidate will conduct usability and resonance testing, concept validation testing for our supply chain robotics solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in user research methodologies, a passion for understanding user needs, and the ability to translate insights into actionable recommendations. You will collaborate with UX designers, product managers, and engineers to ensure our robotic systems and software interfaces are intuitive, efficient, and aligned with user expectations.
What You’ll Do
Conduct Resonance Testing{{:}} Design and execute resonance testing to gauge user reactions, emotional responses, and alignment with proposed design concepts for robotics interfaces and software.
Perform Concept Validation{{:}} Plan and conduct studies to validate design concepts, ensuring they meet user needs and business objectives within the supply chain and robotics context.
Execute Usability Testing{{:}} Develop and lead usability testing sessions for prototypes, existing systems, and new features, identifying pain points and opportunities for improvement.
Gather User Insights{{:}} Use qualitative and quantitative methods, such as interviews, surveys, and observations, to understand user behaviors, preferences, and challenges in interacting with robotic systems.
Analyze and Synthesize Data{{:}} Translate research findings into clear, actionable insights through reports, presentations, and visualizations to guide design and development teams.
Collaborate with Cross-Functional Teams{{:}} Work closely with UX designers, product managers, and engineers to integrate research insights into product development and refine user experiences.
Advocate for Users{{:}} Champion user-centered design principles, ensuring user needs are prioritized throughout the product lifecycle.
Stay Current with Trends{{:}} Keep up-to-date with UX research methodologies, supply chain technologies, and robotics trends to inform research practices.
What You’ll Need
Experience{{:}} Minimum of 2 years of professional experience in UX research, ideally with exposure to technical systems, robotics, or supply chain industries.
Education{{:}} Bachelor’s degree in Human-Computer Interaction, Psychology, Design, Anthropology, or a related field. A Master’s degree is a plus.
Technical Skills{{:}}
Proficiency in UX research methodologies, including resonance testing, concept validation, and usability testing.
Experience with research tools such as Miro, UserTesting, Lookback, or similar platforms for conducting and analyzing studies.
Familiarity with data analysis tools (e.g., Excel, SPSS, or Tableau) for quantitative research.
Knowledge of supply chain operations or robotics systems is a plus.
Soft Skills{{:}}
Strong analytical skills to interpret complex data and derive meaningful insights.
Excellent communication and presentation skills to share findings with diverse stakeholders.
Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional team environment.
Preferred Qualifications{{:}}
Experience conducting research for hardware-software integrated systems, such as robotics.
Understanding of accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG) to ensure inclusive user experiences.
Our environment
Up to 10% of travel may be required. Employees must have a valid driver’s license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client and other customer locations.
The employee is responsible for owning a credit card and managing expenses personally to be reimbursed on a bi-weekly basis.
About Symbotic
Symbotic is an automation technology leader reimagining the supply chain with its end-to-end, AI-powered robotic and software platform. Symbotic reinvents the warehouse as a strategic asset for the world’s largest retail, wholesale, and food & beverage companies. Applying next-gen technology, high-density storage and machine learning to solve today's complex distribution challenges, Symbotic enables companies to move goods with unmatched speed, agility, accuracy and efficiency. As the backbone of commerce the Symbotic platform transforms the flow of goods and the economics of supply chain for its customers. For more information, visit www.symbotic.com.

title: Researcher - Games
description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.
Netflix Games is seeking a Researcher, Games to conduct user research that guides the development of a diverse slate of games across cloud and mobile platforms. You will conduct studies and analyses to ensure Netflix is prioritizing insights from our members and players - specifically, understanding their needs, behaviors, and feedback. We’re looking for someone with ample experience impacting games with research, influencing game product partners, and managing multiple diverse games in a fast-paced environment. This is an opportunity to help the organization understand and deliver on player needs.
This role sits within the Games Consumer Insights team, which blends audience insights with UX Research to provide a holistic view of our players.
Responsibilities
Conduct user research throughout game development, from prototype to late stages (alpha and beta).
Stand up and manage user research testing - including moderated/unmoderated, large/small scaled, employee/player facing, and closed/open playtests for both cloud and mobile games.
Share your results with studio partners and game leaders in concise, data-informed presentations that drive clear actions that benefit our games and players.
Stay close to developer needs and be flexible with emergent needs throughout development.
Improve and maintain playtesting capabilities (whether leaning on external facilities or conducting in-house), ensuring environments meet the needs of diverse games and teams.
Improve existing processes for participant recruitment, build distribution, player segmentation, feedback collection, and data reporting.
Track and report on key metrics to demonstrate the impact on game quality and business outcomes.
Stay current on industry trends and emerging technologies in playtesting and user research.
Requirements
4+ years of hands-on experience conducting user research, especially in running playtests that yield both qualitative and quantitative measures.
Experience in a variety of user research paradigms and specs, including:
Remote and in-person

title: Rapid User Researcher
description:
Who We Are
Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.
Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.
About The Role
We’re seeking a
Rolling User Researcher (Rolling UXR)
to deliver fast, high-signal insights that improve Notion’s product experiences across Product, Design, and Engineering (EPD)—including
AI-powered workflows
like Notion custom agents and chat. This is a
tactical, high-velocity
role: you’ll run lightweight usability and concept tests on a steady cadence, identify what’s not working, and help teams translate feedback into concrete product changes. Besides conducting research, you’ll also build and scale a program that makes it easy for product teams to submit testing requests and easy for you to recruit participants, along with a prioritization framework that helps you focus on the most important work.
This role is ideal for a researcher who loves the craft of moderated testing, can context-switch across many teams, and thrives in a “many small studies” model.
This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.
What You'll Achieve
End-to-end tactical research: Scope, design, and execute quick-turn research across the product lifecycle—delivering clear recommendations that drive product decisions, including
Rolling usability testing: Plan and moderate rapid usability tests on prototypes and in-product flows; identify friction, comprehension gaps, and failure points; recommend practical fixes and prototype them with AI.
Concept testing: Help teams evaluate early ideas (storyboards, low/high-fidelity prototypes, new IA) to understand desirability, comprehension, and expected workflows—before teams invest heavily in build.
Research pipeline ownership: Keep an always-on motion healthy by managing intake/prioritization, study cadence, participant recruitment, and consistent output formats so partners know what to expect and can act quickly.
Communication: Deliver crisp, actionable recommendation (severity, confidence, recommended next steps) in the right format for the audience—async write-ups, clips, or working sessions.
Business-minded impact: Connect findings to outcomes—why an issue matters, what to change, and what to watch—then follow through with teams to ensure improvements land.
Skills You'll Need To Bring
Research craft: You can independently run usability and/or concept tests end-to-end (scoping → protocol → moderation → synthesis → readout), and you know how to keep scope tight while preserving rigor. You’re also comfortable using AI thoughtfully to speed up prep/synthesis while maintaining quality and traceability to evidence.
AI fluency: You’re curious and hands-on with AI products and can translate concepts, like trust, usefulness, tone, safety, and clarity, into observable behaviors and research questions.
Pragmatism + speed: You excel at prioritizing in fast-moving environments, are comfortable with ambiguity, and can deliver quality research quickly with transparent limitations.
Systems thinking: You can quickly understand complex user journeys and identify where experiences break down across the system—from inputs, to product behavior, to UI patterns.
Communication: You write clearly, facilitate effectively, and can translate messy data into decisions and next steps for busy EPD partners.
Collaboration: You’re comfortable working across many stakeholders and switching context quickly without dropping details.
Experience: 3+ years of hands-on UX research experience (industry, agency, or equivalent)
Nice To Haves
Familiarity with AI-enabled product experiences (e.g., assistants/agents) and how to evaluate workflow success, user expectations, and trust.
Comfort collaborating on research-operations basics (recruiting, scheduling, etc.) to keep a rolling cadence healthy.
Background in UX design, engineering, or similar.

You’ll embody inclusive behaviours. You’ll understand the importance of inclusive research practices, taking pride in ensuring research is representative of a wide range of people and communities.
You’ll be an active part of the UCD community sharing insights and practices within the community and across the organisation.
Your work will help UKHSA to solve problems, improve public health outcomes and address health inequalities.
As a User Researcher, You’ll:
carry out user research activities, creating research plans, recruiting participants, preparing discussion guides, creating information gathering artefacts, running and moderating user research sessions
analyse and synthesise user research data to present clear and engaging user insights and actionable findings, using creative approaches to storytelling
contribute to the improvement of user research practice and ways of working by adhering to and embedding consistent and high-quality professional standards
drive awareness of user research practices, advocating for user needs and user research to be embedded within strategy, policy and service design
work collaboratively and in an inclusive manner by involving teams and colleagues from across UKHSA in user research to help everyone develop a deep understanding of UKHSA’s users’ needs
act as the voice of users in the design of our services, make actionable recommendations based on insights and communicate these to stakeholders clearly and confidently
ensure research practice is high quality and meets government and NHS standards and industry best practice – using peer reviews and critique processes to gather feedback and share best practice
actively contribute to the UKHSA’s community of practice, advocate for user research and support the creation of the right environment and processes to establish the profession within UKHSA
This is not an exhaustive list.

title: Staff UX Researcher
description:
Our Mission
Launched in 2012, Tinder® revolutionized how people meet, growing from 1 match to one billion matches in just two years. This rapid growth demonstrates its ability to fulfill a fundamental human need: real connection. Today, the app has been downloaded over 630 million times, leading to over 97 billion matches, serving approximately 50 million users per month in 190 countries and 45+ languages - a scale unmatched by any other app in the category. In 2024, Tinder won four Effie Awards for its first-ever global brand campaign, “It Starts with a Swipe”™"
Our Values
One Team, One Dream
We work hand-in-hand, building Tinder for our members. We succeed together when we work collaboratively across functions, teams, and time zones, and think outside the box to achieve our company vision and mission.
Own It
We take accountability and strive to make a positive impact in all aspects of our business, through ownership, innovation, and a commitment to excellence.
Never Stop Learning
We cultivate a culture where it’s safe to take risks. We seek out input, share honest feedback, celebrate our wins, and learn from our mistakes in order to continue improving.
Spark Solutions
We’re problem solvers, focusing on how to best move forward when faced with obstacles. We don’t dwell on the past or on the issues at hand, but instead look at how to stay agile and overcome hurdles to achieve our goals.
Embrace Our Differences
We are intentional about building a workplace that reflects the rich diversity of our members. By leveraging different perspectives and other ways of thinking, we build better experiences for our members and our team.
We are looking for a passionate and experienced Staff UX Researcher to work on our team and collaborate with partners across Product, Data, Voice of the Customer/CX, and more. As a Staff UX Researcher at Tinder, you will lead large-scale, complex research initiatives, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality research insights that drive strategic product decisions, inform our product roadmap, and help us design and develop products that enhance the user experience.
What You'll Do:
Drive and execute large-scale, complex UX Research projects from inception to completion, including planning, design, data collection, analysis, and reporting
Design and conduct innovative qualitative and quantitative studies, including usability testing, user interviews, surveys, ethnographic studies, and advanced data analysis
Translate complex research data into clear, actionable insights that inform product strategy, design decisions, and user experience improvements
Bring user insights to life to communicate research findings using storytelling techniques including video, data visualization, personas, journey maps, and more
Work closely with product managers, designers, engineers, and other stakeholders to identify research needs and align research objectives with business goals
Champion user-centered design principles and ensure the voice of the user is consistently represented in all stages of product development
Closely collaborate with the Voice of the Customer (VoC) team to integrate customer feedback and insights into research findings, ensuring a holistic understanding of user needs and pain points
Communicate VoC effectively to all levels of the organization
Communicate, influence and drive decision-making with executive stakeholders via storytellingProvide mentorship and guidance to junior researchers and team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning, professional growth, and excellence
Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Human-Computer Interaction, Psychology, Sociology, Anthropology, or a related field
7+ years of hands-on experience in UX Research within a product organization, with a proven track record of leading impactful research projects and driving product success
Expertise in a wide range of research mix-methodologies and tools, including advanced qualitative and quantitative approaches
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize complex data into clear and actionable insights
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, including executive leadership
Demonstrated experience in an agile development environment and a deep understanding of product design processes
Strong leadership and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across cross-functional teams
Preferred Qualifications:
Master's or Ph.D. degree in a related field
Experience using ML/AI to synthesize qualitative and quantitative insights at scaleLeadership experience in a UX Research team, with a history of mentoring and developing junior researchers
Domain expertise in a specific area relevant to our product, particularly in the dating space
Proficiency with advanced research tools and software like eye-tracking
A strong portfolio showcasing a diverse range of research projects and their tangible impact on product outcomes
Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

We strive to build a workplace that reflects the rich diversity of our members around the world, and we value unique perspectives and backgrounds. title: User Researcher
description:
Corporate Resources and Business Improvement (CRBI)
The Resources and Business Improvement directorate is led by Dianne Tranmer. It is responsible for: People Function, Facilities Management, Digital Experience Unit and Technology Group, Information Governance, Executive Support Team and leadership of all our shared services across the GLA Group.
About The Team
The UCD team brings together specialisms including digital engagement, service design, user research, business analysis, content and interaction design and performance analysis. These specialisms work in harmony with a shared mission to make all products and services as inclusive, accessible and user centric as possible.
About The Role
Plan and conduct user research of GLA products and services, working in the open with the user at the centre of all you do, including working across multiple projects concurrently.
Advocate for a user-centred mindset and user research skills as key to digital transformation and development across the GLA, supporting teams and building up and maintaining a user research knowledge base.
What your day will look like
Run end-to-end user research, including framing research questions and objectives, employing inclusive and rigorous methods, analysing data, synthesising findings, and producing research outputs that clearly communicate user needs and inform decision making.
Work with teams across the GLA to help them understand, map and articulate their objectives. Help them understand agile ways of working, the value user research brings and help them articulate their digital transformation possibilities. Support teams within the GLA in making decisions which lead to improved services and products that better meet user needs.
Work across complex business areas and multidisciplinary teams to analyse and articulate user need. Create research and analysis plans to help gather evidence to guide decision-making in nuanced areas where simple answers are not possible; build and execute backlogs of work; use data to ensure services are accessible, intuitive, simple, and inclusive.
Work with product teams throughout the development lifecycle. Measure value and use qualitative and quantitative data to inform decisions. Add evidence to user stories. Take considered, data-driven decisions and learn from mistakes. Track and monitor performance and outcomes to aid iteration and improvements.
Use agile methodology and an agile mindset to all aspects of your work. Build collaborative relationships with colleagues and suppliers in a fast-paced, evolving environment and use an iterative method and flexible approach to enable quick delivery.
Produce user research outputs that contribute to a research and insight knowledge base that can provide understanding about Londoners needs and how GLA policies and programmes can use digital to help meet those needs. Help guide organisational decision-making by communicating research best practice.
Support the Senior User Researcher to establish user research as a function at the GLA. Set standards and behavioural expectations for user researchers and embed user research as a function into the delivery of all digital and data services and products. Build up and maintain a user research community, as well as knowledge base.
Act as an advocate for user-centred design and development across the GLA. Advocate for user research at all levels in the organisation, helping to break down the barriers to opening up and listening.
Quality assure the work of others (including suppliers) to ensure it meets our design standards.
Manage resources as allocated to the job in accordance with the Authority’s policies and Code of Ethics and Standards.
Realise the benefits of a flexible approach to work in undertaking the duties and responsibilities of this job, and participating in multi-disciplinary, cross-department and cross-organisational groups and project teams.
Realise the benefits of London’s diversity by promoting and enabling equality of opportunities and promoting the diverse needs and aspirations of London’s communities.
Key contacts
Accountable to:
Lead Service Designer
Accountable for:
Resources allocated to the job
Principal contacts:
User Centred Design colleagues, GLA policy teams, managers and officers across the organisation, Londoners, Product Managers, Delivery Managers, Testers, Product Owners, contractors and external suppliers, Digital Experience Unit colleagues, Marketing, Events
Skills, Knowledge And Experience
To be considered for the role you must meet the following
essential criteria
:
Proven experience of the user research profession and skills including excellent understanding of user-centred design and service design.
Ability to design rigorous research, use diverse methods to elicit insights into user and staff needs, analyse and synthesise data, and translate these into recommendations and reports that inform decision making.
Experience working as a user researcher in teams building products from inception to live. Successful track record of working across multidisciplinary teams to deliver digital products using agile methodologies.
Can demonstrate a good understanding of inclusive research and digital inclusion and has experience of engaging diverse groups of users and stakeholders in appropriate research activities to deliver accessible online services.
Has good experience working with multiple stakeholders with different interests, demonstrating empathy, building relationships, managing expectations and working under pressure and change.
Experience delivering user research to support the product development lifecycle. Ability to build and execute a backlog of work, translating user need into user stories for the product team to deliver against.
Experience of working across modern technology platforms, including cloud technology, architecture, agile delivery methods and software practices.
Can demonstrate strong research communications skills. Able to gather, distil, and simplify large amount of data, judging what is and isn’t important, including writing reports that quickly help someone understand the problem to be solved. Can explain what users need succinctly, to a diverse, non-expert audience.
Desirable
Knowledge of the cross-government DDAT framework and wider developments in government digital transformation.
Experimentation and innovation techniques.
Coaching and mentoring skills.
Passionate about tech for good and with a proven desire to work in a public service organisation solving complex problems.
Passionate about building diverse teams and communities
Experience persuading organisations which have not yet embraced digital ways of working to adopt product and design thinking.
Experience working in digital in the public sector.
Experience taking an active part in the public sector digital community.
Experience working with APIs and microservices architecture and managing the relationships between interdependent product and platform teams.
Behavioural competencies
Research and Analysis
… is gathering intelligence (information, opinion and data) from varied sources, making sense of it, testing its validity and drawing conclusions that can lead to practical benefits.
Level 3 Indicators:
Expands networks to gain new information sources for research and policy development
Identifies and implements methods to ensure intelligence is of a high quality
Encourages others to analyse data from different angles, using multiple perspectives to identify connections and new insights
Tailors research investment in line with likely impact for Londoners and policy priorities
Retains a bigger picture view, ensuring research recommendations are appropriate and practical for the GLA and its stakeholders
Problem solving
… is analysing and interpreting situations from a variety of viewpoints and finding creative, workable and timely solutions.
Level 3 Indicators:
Clarifies ambiguous problems, questioning assumptions to reach a fuller understanding
Actively challenges the status quo to find new ways of doing things, looking for good practice
Seeks and incorporates diverse perspectives to help produce workable strategies to address complex issues
Initiates consultation on opportunities to improve work processes
Supports the organisation to implement innovative suggestions
Stakeholder Focus
… is consulting with, listening to and understanding the needs of those our work impacts and using this knowledge to shape what we do and manage others’ expectations.
Level 3 Indicators:
Understands diverse stakeholder needs and tailors team deliverables accordingly
Is a role model to others, encouraging them to think of Londoners first
Manages stakeholder expectations, so they are high but realistic
Removes barriers to understanding the needs of diverse stakeholders, including hard to reach groups
Focuses own and team’s efforts on delivering a quality and committed service
Communicating and Influencing
… is presenting information and arguments clearly and convincingly so that others see us as credible and articulate, and engage with us.
Level 3 indicators
Encourages and supports teams in engaging in transparent and inclusive communication
Influences others and gains buy-in using compelling, well thought through arguments
Negotiates effectively to deliver GLA priorities
Synthesises the complex viewpoints of others, recognises where compromise is necessary and brokers agreement
Advocates positively for the GLA both within and outside the organisation
Strategic thinking
…is using an understanding of the bigger picture to uncover potential challenges and opportunities for the long term and turning these into a compelling vision for action.
Level 2 Indicators:
