title: Platform Engineer, Automation
description:
About Us
Dorsia is at the forefront of hospitality-tech innovation, redefining how the world gains access to the most in-demand restaurants, events, and experiences. By fusing cutting-edge technology with the art of luxury hospitality, we empower our members to secure impossible-to-get reservations while providing operators with unprecedented levels of control, visibility, and revenue optimization.
In 2025, we grew revenue 480% and scaled to 400+ venues across 25 destinations, with the launch of our Culture Calendar extending Dorsia beyond restaurants into the world’s most sought-after cultural moments.
Backed by $54M in funding from investors including Index Ventures, Invus, and Red Sea Ventures, and strategic partners including MoonPay, Major Food Group, and The Dinex Group - Daniel Boulud, we are entering our most consequential phase of growth and reshaping the global hospitality landscape. We’re adding exceptional talent to drive what comes next, and that’s where you come in.
About The Role
Dorsia is seeking an
Automation Engineer
to sit at the intersection of product quality and operational intelligence. You will own two things that matter equally: ensuring our platform ships reliably through robust automated testing, and identifying the repetitive, manual, and error-prone workflows across the company that should no longer exist.
The ideal candidate is genuinely product-minded and comfortable operating across the full scope of a problem. You have a bias toward shipping, a low tolerance for toil, and a habit of asking whether something should be automated before accepting that it has to be done by hand.
What You'll Do
Product Quality and Test Automation
Design, implement, and maintain automated test suites across unit, integration, and end-to-end layers for our core products.
Own and evolve our test automation framework, including tools like Maestro, Playwright, Cypress, or equivalent API testing approaches.
Integrate automated tests into the CI/CD pipeline and keep the build signal clean and trustworthy.
Partner with Engineers and Product Managers to define and validate acceptance criteria for new features before they ship.
Monitor test runs for flakiness and failures, and drive improvements that fix them durably rather than paper over them.
Contribute to test strategy and coverage planning, with particular focus on high-risk and high-impact surfaces.
Internal Automation and Tooling
Proactively identify repetitive, manual, or error-prone workflows across the company, spanning engineering, ops, support, and GTM.
Design and implement automations using AI tools and LLMs for classification, summarization, routing, and generation; low/no-code platforms like Zapier, Make, n8n, or Retool; and lightweight Python or TypeScript scripts that connect systems together.
Use AI-assisted coding to prototype quickly, then harden promising prototypes into maintainable, observable production systems.
Integrate automations with the tools the team already relies on, including Slack, CRMs, ticketing systems, and internal APIs.
Work with stakeholders to map processes, define requirements, and iterate toward solutions that actually get used.
Reliability, Observability, and Maintenance
Ensure automations and test systems are reliable, debuggable, and documented well enough that someone else can understand and fix them.
Implement monitoring and alerting for critical automations, covering error rates, latency, and failure notifications.
Own the full lifecycle of automations: from idea through prototype, production, iteration, and eventual deprecation.
Regularly review and prune unused, flaky, or low-value automations to keep the surface area manageable.
Collaboration and Culture
Work closely with product, engineering, and operations to prioritize what to automate based on actual impact.
Communicate tradeoffs clearly, build versus buy, and automation complexity versus benefit, without waiting to be asked.
Help establish an automation-first mindset across the team, encouraging others to think in terms of systems and reusable workflows.
Share knowledge through documentation and playbooks that are clear enough for non-engineers to follow and build on.
The Winning Recipe
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
3-5 years of experience in a QA automation, software engineering, or workflow automation role.
Strong hands-on experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or equivalent.
Comfortable writing Python and TypeScript/JavaScript at a level that produces clean, maintainable, production-grade code.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and a track record of keeping build signals reliable.
Demonstrated ability to ship internal automations using low/no-code platforms, LLM-powered tooling, and scripting.
Solid understanding of APIs and how to connect systems that weren't designed to talk to each other.
Strong written communication, including documentation that is actually useful long after the sprint ends.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, complex environment involving cross-functional projects.
A genuine interest in the Dorsia product, the member experience, and what it means to build for hospitality at this level.
Strong plus: prior experience with reservation system integrations (SevenRooms, Resy, OpenTable), dining payments infrastructure, or luxury/membership consumer apps.
Compensation And Benefits
Flexible PTO
Medical, dental, and vision insurance
FSA
Commuter benefits
Free membership to One Medical
Teladoc
Talkspace
Kindbody
401(k)
In-office lunch 3 days a week
Employee Dining Credits
Salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and stage. We determine our pay by considering skills and experience related to the role, location, and ensuring internal equity relative to other Dorsia employees.
Compensation
New York Pay Range
$120,000 - $145,000 USD
Workplace Philosophy at Dorsia
At Dorsia, we believe that culture eats strategy. The best ideas in the world mean nothing without the right people around the table and the right chemistry between them. We are, unapologetically, a people-first organization.
In-Person Matters
We’re creating once-in-a-lifetime experiences for the most discerning audience in the world. That doesn’t happen over Zoom. It happens through collisions: a spark across a desk, a kitchen-side conversation that unlocks a partnership, the energy of ideas felt, not typed. That’s why in-office culture is non-negotiable at Dorsia.
Who We Hire
We don’t subscribe to check-the-box hiring. We hire for merit and mindset, which naturally creates a team with varied backgrounds. What unites us isn’t demographics, it’s a shared vision: to build the social operating system for the cultural vanguard.
Lifestyle Hours
We’re not a 9-to-5 company. Our lifestyle mirrors our members. Early flights, after-work events, and late-night sprints when the work demands it. But we love what we do, and we definitely love a good party.
High Performance Culture
Working at Dorsia isn’t for everyone—and that’s the point. Our culture is designed for builders, not passengers. We move fast, set ambitious standards, and expect people to rise to them. If you have the talent and the drive, this will be a ride to remember.
A Final Word
We’re building something special. It will take long hours and relentless effort. It’s not for everyone. For those with the metabolism, you’ll create something that changes how culture is lived. And that’s the kind of work worth your life’s energy.

title: Automated Test Engineer
description:
Location:
Fortitude Valley (Brisbane) / Hybrid
Position Description
Role Overview
As a Test Automation Engineer at Antero, you will play a crucial role in building SaaS products and supporting bespoke software for our clients. Reporting to the CTO, you will sit within our technology team here in Brisbane at our Fortitude Valley office, collaborating with developers, product owners, and our QA team to give us the confidence to release across our growing array of code bases.
The key to success in this role is a genuine passion for quality, clean, well-tested code, meaningful coverage, and automation that lets the whole team ship without fear. You will define and champion the “Antero way” of testing: the standards, patterns, and practices that make our test suites something the team trusts and acts on.
Core Competencies
A software development background with the ability to design, write, and maintain automated test suites across the front end and back end.
A passion for quality code, test coverage, and automation, with the judgement to know what is worth testing and how.
Ability to translate testing best practice into clear, repeatable standards, and to mentor and upskill others in applying them.
An aptitude for understanding and interpreting the logic and process that sits behind data driven technology systems and testing the parameters they should operate within.
Key Responsibilities
Release Confidence Across Our Code Bases:
Defining the “Antero Way” of Testing:
Establish and document testing standards, patterns, and conventions for our projects.
Define what good coverage looks like at each layer of the stack, and embed these standards into our day-to-day development workflow.
Upskilling and Mentoring the QA Team:
Work alongside our technical QA team to grow their automation and software development capability.
Run training, pairing, and review sessions that lift the team’s confidence in writing and maintaining automated tests.
Tooling and CI/CD Integration:
Build and maintain automated tests across TypeScript, React, Jest, React Testing Library, and Playwright. Apply the same rigour across PHP, Laravel, PHPUnit, and Docker.
Integrate automated testing into our CI/CD pipelines (Buddy and GitHub) so tests run reliably as part of every change.
Keep test suites fast, stable, and trustworthy, so results are believed and acted on rather than ignored.
Communication and Documentation:
Document standards and present them clearly to the wider technology team.
Communicate coverage, gaps, and quality risks to developers, product owners, and the CTO using Jira and Confluence.
Quality Assurance Methodology and Best Practices:
Contribute to and continuously improve Antero’s quality engineering methodology and best-practice framework.
Stay ahead of industry trends in test automation and bring better ways of working back to the team.
A Little About Us
Antero is a SaaS product and bespoke software provider which is part of the Flip Group, including weareflip our creative agency partner, and Khemistry, our behaviour change partner. Antero develops its own SaaS products specific to FinTech and financial markets in addition to providing software consultation and bespoke software development for our clients. Our flagship product Incept is used by several Asset Finance companies within Australia providing a FinTech platform in a box to accelerate loan origination, credit decisioning, settlements, doc gen, etc.
Our Workplace
we have a development team alongside a highly talented creative team, keeping the work interesting and of incredible quality
we have a hybrid work from home policy usually 3 or 2 days in the office, but we are flexible
we offer training opportunities for staff who are interested in upskilling
we’re a genuinely good bunch of folks with an interest in high quality results
we’re growing year on year
our office is a plant-filled oasis with amazing food and coffee a stone’s throw away
this is the place to do good work and learn new things
What else can I expect from this role?
In addition to the core responsibilities, the Test Automation Engineer may engage in performance and load testing to evaluate the scalability and responsiveness of our platforms, analysing results and recommending improvements. You may help shape how we use AI tooling such as Claude to write, review, and accelerate testing, and continuously identify and implement process improvements while staying updated with industry trends. As the most senior testing voice in the team, you will mentor QA team members and lead training sessions on new tools, techniques, and standards.
How do I know if I qualify for this role?
Capability in this role will be measured through the following activities:
Demonstrating hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining automated test suites across a modern web stack.
Showcasing a software development background, including familiarity with TypeScript/React and PHP/Laravel ecosystems, developer tooling, and CI/CD pipelines.
Writing or reviewing automated tests for a given feature, explaining your coverage decisions and the trade-offs behind them.
Walking us through how you would introduce and document a testing standard, and how you would bring an existing team along with you.
If this sounds like your kind of place the next steps for you to follow are:
email a copy of your CV / Portfolio / GoPro video to careers@antero.com.au
within a few days you’ll receive a tech test which helps us to better understand your skill level and where you’ll fit in the team
for those who successfully complete the tech test you will receive an interview where we can discuss your results and where you might fit within our team

description:

Summary
We are seeking a forward-thinking SDET to help modernize and lead our test automation strategy. To be clear, the candidate needs to understand why they are doing what they are doing and be able to clearly articulate it to others (not an order taker).
This role will focus on building and maintaining scalable, maintainable, and integrated test automation frameworks across UI and API layers using modern tools like Playwright and TypeScript, while also contributing to CI/CD testing integration. You will serve as a key technical expert and bridge between regional teams, global R&D, Control Engineering, Technical Marketing, and Grid Compliance groups. simulation-backed data and reports
to support technical marketing, white papers, and brand authority.

Collaborate with Sales and Technical solution engineering teams to provide expert technical input during bidding and project phases.
Laboratory Technical Support
Perform hands-on
testing and validation
work in the state-of-the-art real-time HIL laboratory.
Support efficient scheduling and utilization of test resources to meet project deadlines.

5+ years
of hands-on experience in
real-time simulation, HIL testing
, or inverter/BESS control validation.

Strong proficiency with real-time simulation platforms and the
ability to build, run, and troubleshoot complex models
.
Deep understanding of utility-scale PV inverters and BESS operation, control strategies, and grid behavior.

title: Vehicle Technician | Dubai, UAE
description:
About Moove
Moove is building the world’s largest fleet and best-in-class technologies to power mobility platforms. Our flagship Drive-to-Own (DTO) product democratises access to vehicle ownership with a revolutionary revenue-based financing model, enabling underserved mobility entrepreneurs to thrive.
Our global growth has been fuelled by our partnership with Uber and backed by leading investors and lenders, including Uber, Mubadala, BlackRock, and many others. Today, Moove operates the world's largest manned & autonomous ride-hail fleet, with 38k+ vehicles across 29 cities, 13 countries and 6 continents enabled by 2.1k+ employees – Moove continues to expand through strategic partnerships with industry leaders like Uber. We’re transforming mobility to be safer, more efficient, and accessible to all, while creating economic opportunities and supporting skills development in the mobility sector.
About The Role
As a Vehicle Technician, you are the specialist eyes on our autonomous vehicle sensor stack and mechanical assembly. You will inspect, test, and validate the hardware components that make our vehicles see and think; Lidar, Radar, cameras, and compute units as well as the physical mounting systems, wiring harnesses, and mechanical assemblies that hold everything together and ensure every system meets operational and safety standards before deployment.
This is a junior to mid-level hands-on technical role specializing in the inspection, testing, and quality assurance of AV self-driving system hardware and its mechanical integration. You will work closely with engineering staff and the AV Safety Manager to identify hardware defects, validate sensor performance, check mechanical integrity, document findings accurately, and support root cause analysis when issues arise. You are not a software engineer but you understand how hardware behaves, how to test it methodically, and how to flag when something is wrong.
What You’ll Be Doing
Hardware Inspection and Validation
Conduct structured inspections of AV self-driving system hardware including Lidar, Radar, cameras, ultrasonic sensors, and compute units
Verify correct installation, alignment, physical condition, and connectivity of all sensor hardware following defined inspection checklists and partner SOPs
Perform functional hardware checks and sensor readiness validations as part of the pre-deployment clearance process
Conduct post-repair hardware inspections to confirm defects have been correctly resolved before vehicle redeployment
Assess impact of environmental conditions heat, dust, humidity on sensor hardware performance and flag anomalies
Mechanical Inspection and Assembly Integrity
Inspect all sensor mounting hardware brackets, fasteners, clamps, and vibration isolators for correct installation, torque, and physical condition
Verify cable routing, strain relief, and connector seating across the full sensor wiring harness, flagging any chafe, pinch, or unseated connection
Check enclosure seals, gaskets, and IP rated fittings to ensure ingress protection against dust and moisture critical in Dubai operating conditions
Perform post-maintenance underbody and chassis-level inspections to confirm no mechanical disturbance from prior service activity
Identify and escalate loose, corroded, or fatigued mechanical components before they cause sensor misalignment or vehicle downtime
Maintain a structured mechanical inspection log alongside hardware QA records so both disciplines are traceable in the fleet maintenance system
Testing and Characterization
Execute defined hardware performance tests and bench characterization procedures to verify sensor output against acceptance criteria
Support calibration procedures for Lidar, Radar, and camera systems in accordance with partner technical standards
Operate onboard diagnostic tools and software interfaces to assess hardware health and data quality
Document test results accurately using 4Cs standards (Condition, Cause, Correction, Confirmation) in the fleet maintenance management system.
Defect Management and Escalation
Identify, document, and escalate hardware defects and sensor anomalies through the defined non-conformance process
Track open hardware issues including mechanical defects through to resolution; verify corrective actions before closing
Identify recurring hardware failure patterns and surface structured findings to engineering staff and the AV Safety Manager
Support post-incident technical reviews where hardware performance is a contributing factor
Compliance and Safety
Adhere strictly to high-voltage safety, lockout/tagout, and hazardous material handling protocols at all times
Follow mechanical safety protocols when working around high-torque fasteners, suspension components, and vehicle undercarriage including correct use of vehicle lifts and jack stands
Maintain audit-ready hardware inspection and test records
Ensure all hardware QA activities, electronic and mechanical, comply with partner technical standards and UAE regulatory requirements
What You Will Need For This Position
Diploma or bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Physics, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field preferred
2 to 5 years of experience in hardware testing, electronics QA, light mechanical maintenance, or AV/automotive technical operations
Hands-on experience with optical, electrical, or sensor hardware preferred; Lidar or Radar familiarity a strong advantage
Practical experience with mechanical assembly, fastener systems, torque tools, and basic vehicle maintenance even from an automotive, aerospace, or industrial background
Comfortable operating diagnostic tools, software interfaces, and onboard vehicle systems
Strong attention to detail; methodical and thorough in inspection, testing, and documentation
Basic data analysis skills; comfortable working with test outputs, logs, and performance data
Able to lift and carry assemblies exceeding 25 kg and stand for extended periods
Valid UAE driving license preferred
What Does Success Look Like
All AV hardware inspected and validated to standard before every deployment
Defects identified early, documented accurately, and resolved completely
Recurring hardware issues surfaced to engineering before they become operational problems
A sensor stack that performs reliably because the QA bar never moves
Mechanical assemblies are consistently in spec no deployment is delayed by a loose mount, failed seal, or unseated connector that should have been caught at inspection
Who You'll Be Working with:
Directly reporting to our Fleet Operations Manager, and closely working with our Operations Team.
About The Team
Our team is collaborative, positive, curious, and engaged. We think fast, work smart, laugh often, and are looking for like-minded people to join us in our mission to disrupt vehicle ownership and make financial freedom within reach.
Moove is strongly committed to diversity within its community. The Company’s approved Employment Equity Plan and Targets will be considered as part of the recruitment process. As an Equal Opportunities employer, we welcome people from all backgrounds who seek the opportunity to help build a future where everyone and everything can move independently.

Any misrepresentations, falsifications, or material omissions in any information or data provided by an applicant may result in the applicant being excluded from further consideration for employment or if an individual has already been hired, termination of employment.

description:

Develop comprehensive Testing & Commissioning (T&C) Master Plans, test procedures, and schedules covering all rail sub-systems including signalling, telecoms, traction power, rolling stock, and civil/structural systems
Coordinate and manage T&C activities across multiple contractors, system integrators, and multidisciplinary engineering teams
Conduct static and dynamic testing of railway sub-systems in accordance with approved test procedures and acceptance criteria
Manage and track Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), defects, and punch list items; ensure timely resolution and formal closure prior to system handover
Verify system performance against design specifications, interface requirements, and operational requirements
Coordinate Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) at manufacturer facilities and oversee Site Acceptance Tests (SAT) for all installed systems
Manage the integrated system testing (IST) and trial running phases, ensuring safe and effective coordination between all systems
Ensure all T&C activities are performed in compliance with the project Safety Management System (SMS) and site safety rules
Prepare and maintain test records, commissioning logs, certificates, and handover documentation
Coordinate with the System Assurance team to ensure all test evidence supports safety case requirements and regulatory approvals
Support operational readiness reviews and provide technical input to operations and maintenance training programmes
Prepare lessons learned reports and contribute to continuous improvement of T&C processes.
Key Competencies
Experience with integrated system testing in metro, light rail, or heavy rail environments.
Knowledge of railway testing standards and commissioning methodologies.
Strong coordination and organisational skills for managing multi-discipline test programmes.
Familiarity with configuration management and document control systems.

B.S. or M.S. in Engineering preferred (Electrical Engineering preferred).
15+ years' experience in engineering (10+ years' experience in rail and transit engineering in Middle East).

title: Quality Engineer
description:
Job Description:
Quality Engineer
Job Description
At Nextpower, we are leading in the energy transition, providing the most comprehensive portfolio of intelligent solar tracker and control software solutions for solar power plants, as well as strategic services to capture the full value of solar power plants for our customers. Our talented worldwide teams are transforming PV plant performance every day with smart technology, data monitoring and analysis services.
As a company driving the clean energy transition, sustainability is not just a word. It's a core part of our business and our operations. Our sustainability efforts are based on five cornerstones: People, Community, Environment, Innovation, and Integrity. We are creative, collaborative and passionate problem-solvers from diverse backgrounds, driven by our shared mission to provide smart solar and software solutions for our customers and to mitigate climate change for future generations. Make your mark with Nextpower.
The Quality Engineer will be based in Saudi Arabia. In this position, you will report to the QA/QC Manager. We seek a detail-oriented, experienced Quality Control engineer to ensure smooth production lines generating a consistently top-notch output of products that meet efficiency and quality standards. To be successful as a QC Engineer, you must understand the customer's requirements and coordinate employee efforts between management and the production teams with excellent communication, observational and analytical skills and a demonstrated knowledge of regulatory compliance.
Here is a glimpse of what you’ll do…
Support QC Manager to Develop quality-process links with customers in line with the Quality Management system (including: TS16949, ISO14001 / ISO 9001 / OHAS 18001) Production Part Approval Process (PPAP), Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), Controls Plans, Failure Mode and Effect Analysis (FMEA) and Supplier Quality Assurance (SQA) processes and oversee continued compliance and embedding across the business. Responsible for maintaining relationships with customers and suppliers to maximize profit potential and ensure efficiency. Manage the audit program as well as supplier development and improvement and play a key role in ensuring project deliveries. Work proactively with all Directors, Managers, Supervisors and Employees, to maintain a program of continual improvement within their areas of responsibility. Lead a ‘correct at source’ and problem-solving methodology (Lean). Work to achieve quality targets for customers and business goals.
General Task Management
Ensure that all in-house systems and procedures are updated, revised and modified to meet the needs of external certification bodies.
Respond to customer complaints putting in containment actions, full analysis, poka-yokes (error proofing), and implementing short-term and long-term countermeasures.
Champion a program for the implementation and sustainment of a continuous improvement culture.
Update quality documentation and communicate to carry forward lessons learned from quality concerns.
Ensure that all necessary systems and procedures are in place to satisfy all customer requirements and audits.
Introducing new systems and procedures where appropriate.
Train others in all aspects of the quality system and application of procedures.
Undertake internal and process audits of the Quality Management System (QMS).
Management of the Quality Engineers and Technicians in the sign-off of parts and the resolution of internal/external quality concerns.
Lead regular inspection meetings with representatives from appropriate departments to establish an action plan for improving quality.
In conjunction with the Supplier Quality Assurance function, reduce the effect of non-conforming supplier materials on the production area’s quality.
Perform root cause analysis and resolve problems.
Stay current and up to date on any changes that may affect the supply and demand of needed products and materials and advise others of any impact.
Identify improvement opportunities within the organization.
Identify and deploy the technical skill sets, resource levels and systems to deliver projects, including the engagement of external resources as required.
Develop, implement and manage key performance indicators (KPIs) for each area of responsibility.
Report on achievement of targets and identify any actions required.
Ensure that the function operates in accordance with any health, safety and environmental policies and procedures to ensure the safety and wellbeing of staff and visitors.
Conduct risk assessments of processes and tasks in the department.
People Management
Consistently promote high standards through personal example and roll out through the team so that each member of the team understands the standards and behaviors expected of them.
Monitor the completion of tasks and ensure good performance and record on appropriate systems.
Relationship Management
Work as part of the Management team to share ideas and improve operation, recommending, supporting and implementing continuous improvement activities and process and procedure improvements to optimize results and improve quality of delivery, in line with quality standards requirements delivery in line with Company and Customer requirements.
Develop and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to ensure optimal performance.
Work collaboratively, negotiate and engage with key stakeholders to facilitate delivery and compliance with the strategy.
Here Is Some Of What You’ll Need (required)…
Bachelor of Engineering
Proven 8-10 years of experience as a quality engineer
A results-driven approach and a keen eye for detail
Outstanding verbal and written communication skills
Excellent organizational and leadership skills
Proficiency in Microsoft Office
In-depth knowledge of relevant legal standards and quality control procedures
Good technical and IT skills, working knowledge of SAP or Netsuite will be advantage
Demonstrated knowledge of data analysis/statistical methods
Certification in quality control will be a strong advantage.
Here Are a Few Of Our Preferred Experiences…
Knowledge of various processes from Fabrication, Product Assembly, Plating etc.
Testing skills: based on IEC standards, knowledge of SASO and other international standards
Knowledge / Understanding of any ERP (SAP and NetSuite preferred) and how to integrate with other applications
Must possess business acumen, strong analytical, troubleshooting, problem-solving skills
Knowledge / Experience in customer communications, vendor development and inspection
Knowledge of ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001
Having a strong hold and knowledge of Risk management, SQA, MIS, RoHS compliance, KPIs
Knowledge of Laboratory operations
Command on Arabic language will be advantage
At Nextpower, we are driving the global energy transition with an integrated clean energy technology platform that combines intelligent structural, electrical, and digital solutions for utility-scale power plants. Our comprehensive portfolio enables faster project delivery, higher performance, and greater reliability, helping our customers capture the full value of solar power. Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data-driven insights, and advanced automation. Together, we’re building the foundation for the world’s next generation of clean energy infrastructure.
We are Nextpower

University Hospital Southampton NHS Foundation Trust is delighted to offer a fantastic opportunity to work with us.
Please see below for detailed job description of the role.
Main duties of the job
We’re looking for a driven and enthusiastic Test Analyst to join the My medical Record team. The person will provide excellent software testing skills for the My Medical Record platform, used by many NHS trusts in the UK. Supporting our product and development teams you will plan, perform and execute testing projects, and track and manage issues using Jira and Xray.
The My Medical Record team lead on the development, support and rollout of an industry leading personal health record (PHR), that enables patients to manage their own healthcare whilst away from the hospital. The service supports clinicians and patients at over 25 hospitals around the country, and our work programme is rapidly expanding.
Working for our organisation
University Hospital Southampton is one of England's largest acute teaching Trusts, offering a wide range of learning and development opportunities to support your career aspirations.
Located on the south coast with an international airport and direct rail links to London, Southampton offers an ideal setting to live and work, with the New Forest, South Downs and Jurassic Coast.
We believe that using technology wisely shows strong time management and commitment to innovation. However, personalising your recruitment application to highlight your unique skills and experiences is crucial. Relying too heavily on generic, AI-generated content instead of drawing from your own strengths and accomplishments may lead to your application being rejected if multiple candidates present identical or similar information.
At UHS, we’re committed to providing a flexible working environment where possible. Whether you are balancing family, study, or your wellbeing with your career, we want to support you so you can help our patients.
At UHS, we proudly champion individuality, recognising that outstanding care is only possible with a diverse, inclusive team. We’re committed to creating an anti-racist, anti-discriminatory environment where everyone feels valued, safe, and empowered to make a meaningful impact in our communities. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences to join us in building a healthcare community where everyone can belong, thrive, and contribute.
Detailed Job Description And Main Responsibilities
You will be a key member of the My Medical Record team, helping to ensure the product supports the needs of our customers.
The Key Duties Will Include
Responsibility for performing the testing of the My Medical Record product
Interpreting development requirements when designing test plans
Planning and executing assigned testing projects
Tracking and managing issues, defects and change control relating to product development.
Working closely with the product and development teams to ensure the quality and safety of our software.
What We’re Looking For
We’re looking for a dynamic test analyst with extensive experience of working on complex healthcare applications. We’ll be looking for you to demonstrate experience in:
Working with software testing best practices.
Interpreting complex user stories and acceptance criteria so testing scenarios are fit for purpose.
Excellent communicator and comfortable contributing ideas and solutions to the team.
Experience working to demanding timescales and exacting standards.

Relevant degree (or equivalent), or experience of software testing in a highly complex technical environment
Knowledge and expertise of test methodologies and relevant industry standards.
Knowledge and expertise in test tools e.g. Visual Studio, Team Foundation Server or Jira.
Knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server
Experience writing and executing basic SQL queries
Experience of server operating systems such as Windows Server, Unix/Linux
Desirable criteria
ISTQB foundation or intermediate certificate in software testing.
Able to demonstrate a sound knowledge of relevant NHS clinical and business processes.
Working knowledge of Prince 2

title: Clinical Quality & Patient Safety Officer
description:
Job Summary
The Clinical Quality & Patient Safety Officer is responsible for developing, implementing, and monitoring programs and processes that ensure the delivery of safe, effective, and high-quality clinical care. The role ensures compliance with regulatory requirements, internal quality standards, and best practice guidelines, while fostering a culture of safety, learning, and continuous improvement across all clinical services.
Key Responsibilities
Quality Management & Clinical Governance
Develop and maintain a clinical quality management framework aligned with national regulations, accreditation standards, and company policies.
Oversee the creation, review, and implementation of clinical policies, protocols, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
Conduct regular audits of clinical documentation, patient records, and service delivery to ensure compliance with quality standards.
Monitor performance indicators and prepare quality reports for senior management.
Patient Safety
Lead the development and implementation of patient safety initiatives to minimize risks and prevent adverse events.
Manage incident reporting systems, investigate patient safety incidents, and coordinate root cause analyses (RCA).
Develop corrective and preventive action (CAPA) plans to address identified risks.
Promote a culture of transparency, accountability, and open communication regarding safety issues.
Compliance & Regulatory Requirements
Ensure all clinical practices comply with Ministry of Health regulations, professional licensing requirements, and telemedicine standards.
Prepare for and facilitate external inspections, audits, and accreditation processes.
Maintain updated knowledge of relevant healthcare regulations and patient safety guidelines.
Training & Capacity Building
Design and deliver training programs for clinical staff on quality improvement, patient safety, and risk management.
Provide guidance and support to healthcare providers on adherence to best practice guidelines.
Promote continuous professional development to improve clinical competency and quality outcomes.
Data Analysis & Reporting
Collect and analyze clinical quality and safety data to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
Produce monthly, quarterly, and annual reports on key quality and safety metrics.
Present findings and recommendations to leadership teams.
Education
Qualifications and Experience:
Bachelor’s degree in Medicine, Nursing, Pharmacy, or other healthcare-related field (required).
Master’s degree in Healthcare Quality, Patient Safety, Public Health, or equivalent (preferred).
Experience
Minimum 3–5 years of experience in clinical quality management, patient safety, or healthcare governance.
Experience in telemedicine or digital health services is an advantage.
Familiarity with national and international accreditation standards (e.g.,CBAHI, JCI).
Key Skills And Competencies
Strong knowledge of quality improvement methodologies (PDSA, Six Sigma, etc.).
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Strong communication and training facilitation skills.
Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams.
High attention to detail and commitment to ethical practice.

description:

This role is the Lead Quality Assurance Engineering position for Network Operations, accountable for the quality posture of a portfolio of platinum-tier, day-of-operations systems - internally developed and vendor managed - where failure is felt directly by live airline operations.

Work closely with project members, technical product owners, architects and software engineers to understand the complete context of deliveries, translate complex functional and non-functional requirements in robust end to end tests that exercise the business process.

Support and guide Software Engineers to write and maintain automated functional tests through continuous integration.
Implement, maintain and adapt automation frameworks. Test harnesses to make end to end tests robust.
Ensure Quality Gate requirements are understood by the team and met.
Support the Principal Quality Assurance Engineer with the coordination of major delivery initiatives across multiple domains and environments, ensuring no customer or business impact.

Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related field or relevant experience. An iSQI Certified Agile Tester.

title: QA & Training Lead — Building Systems Data
description:
About the role
Robotic Imaging delivers facilities and equipment reporting for a US client base that includes Fortune 500 retailers, using 3D laser scanning, VR, and AI-driven data extraction. Our Dubai office runs the production and quality backbone behind that work.
We're hiring a QA & Training Lead to own quality and technical competence across our Data Extraction & Operations (DEO) team of ~50 technicians working across two shifts and two platforms. This is not a queue-management or delivery role — it is a knowledge, training, and quality role. Your mission is to turn a large production team into building-systems experts who QA their own and each other's work, so quality is built into every deliverable rather than caught by a single reviewer at the end.
You'll work in close daily contact with our US site team, joining calls at the start of the US East Coast business day to align priorities and set the tone for the next production cycle.
What you'll own
Building-systems knowledge.
Maintain the authoritative reference and train the team across HVAC, Electrical, Gas, Water & Plumbing, Fire Protection, Refrigeration, and Roof — including component identification, nameplate/asset data capture, survey-value calculations (tonnage, amperage, service sizes), and equipment-age decoding.
Platform mastery.
Be fluent in both of our platforms (Firebase and Supabase), know which is used for which client and deliverable, and teach technicians to move between them without confusion.
Training program.
Design and run onboarding and ongoing training for ~50 technicians across day and night shifts — modular curriculum, worked examples, competency checks, and weekly micro-training on the current top error trend.
Certification.
Assess and certify technicians to self-QA and then to peer-QA, building a distributed QA model that removes the single-gatekeeper bottleneck.
Quality standards.
Own the data-tech checklists and the accuracy bar; keep SOPs current across reporting, VR tagging, site surveys, and AI asset-extraction review.
Metrics & continuous improvement.
Track first-pass QA rates, rework rates, and error type by system; report trends and convert the top recurring error into targeted training.
Error catalog.
Maintain a living list of common mistakes and their fixes, and feed them back into the curriculum.
What you'll bring
Strong working knowledge of commercial building systems — MEP, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire, refrigeration — ideally from a BIM, MEP, facilities, surveying, or building-services background.
Experience in a QA, quality, or technical-training capacity, with a demonstrated ability to teach and raise the standard of a team rather than just check work.
Comfort with data platforms and digital survey/QA tools; able to learn client-specific tagging standards, naming conventions, and asset-extraction QA quickly.
Sharp attention to detail — you catch misidentified assets, wrong calculations, naming inconsistencies, and typos, and you can explain
why
they're wrong so they stop recurring.
Excellent spoken and written English and confident communication with a US-based team.
Ability to build structure — SOPs, checklists, training modules — and hold a team to it consistently.
Nice to have
Prior exposure to US commercial retail survey/facilities work.
Familiarity with Matterport, VR tagging workflows, or AI-assisted data extraction review.
Experience certifying or calibrating reviewers across a distributed team.
Working hours & conditions
On-site, Dubai. Six-day working week (Monday–Saturday), with Sunday as the weekly rest day.
Daily overlap with the US East Coast team is a core requirement of this role. The shift is structured so you're available for the start of the US business day — approximately
5:00–7:00 PM Gulf Standard Time
(shifting one hour with US daylight saving) — to lead handoff calls and set priorities for the next cycle.
Compensation
AED 15,000–18,000 per month (gross)
, depending on experience, structured in line with company banding.
Statutory benefits and end-of-service entitlements per UAE law and company policy.

title: QHSE Officer

Working closely with the HSE & FM Manager, HSE and operational teams, the officer will help maintain safe working conditions, regulatory compliance, and the effective implementation and maintenance of the ISO 9001 Quality Management System. Key Responsibilities for this position include but are not limited to:
Quality Management:
Assist the HSE & FM Manager in implementing, maintaining, and continually improve the ISO 9001 Quality Management System in coordination with relevant process owners.
Maintain QMS documentation, process maps, objectives, risks and opportunities, records, and performance indicators.
Coordinate internal audits, management reviews, nonconformities, corrective actions, and certification audits.
Health and Safety Management:
Support the HSE & FM Team in developing, implementing, and enforcing QHSE policies and procedures.
Conduct regular risk assessments, safety audits, and inspections.
Identify hazards, recommend corrective actions, and ensure compliance with safety protocols.
Provide training and awareness sessions to ensure staff adherence to safety standards.
Manage contractor activities and Permit to Work (PTW) and Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) systems to ensure safety compliance.
Incident and Risk Management:
Investigate incidents and near misses, documenting findings and implementing corrective actions.
Support the HSE & FM Manager in improving safety systems based on risk assessments and incident trends.
Emergency Preparedness:
Collaborate on developing and reviewing emergency response plans and procedures.
Conduct emergency drills, ensuring all employees are prepared for potential hazards.
Ensure fire and safety equipment is maintained and fully operational.
Compliance and Reporting:
Maintain accurate records of QHSE inspections, incidents, quality nonconformities, audits, and training sessions.
Assist in preparing reports for internal audits, management, and regulatory permits, approvals, or licences.
Support compliance with applicable quality, health, safety, environmental, legal, customer, and ISO requirements.
Collaboration and Support:
Work closely with Operations, Maintenance, and other relevant stakeholders to improve QHSE performance.
Engage with employees at all levels to promote quality, safety, and environmental awareness.
Stay updated on best practices and industry standards to continually improve the QHSE programme.
Qualifications And Skills
Bachelor's degree in Occupational Health and Safety, Environmental Science, Engineering, Quality Management, or a related field.
NEBOSH IGC certification in Occupational Health and Safety is mandatory.
ISO 9001 Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor certification is required.
First Aid and Fire Safety certifications are desirable.
ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 certification or strong working knowledge is desirable.
Additional certification in quality, health, safety, or environmental management is an advantage.
4–5 years of combined QHSE experience, preferably in a manufacturing, service, laundry, or other process-driven environment.
Proven practical experience implementing and maintaining an ISO 9001 QMS, including controlled documentation, internal audits, nonconformities, corrective actions, management reviews, and certification support.
Experience in hazard identification, risk assessment, HSE inspections, incident investigation, training delivery, rootcause analysis and QHSE report writing.
UAE Driving License Mandatory
Skills
Fluency in English; additional languages are a plus.
Strong communication, analytical, organisational, problem-solving, and follow-up skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
Good to have knowledge of tools such as Notion, Asana, Slack, or similar platforms for collaboration and task management.
Working Conditions
Exposure to various operational environments, including possible exposure to heat, noise, and chemicals.
Occasional travel may be required for site inspections or meetings.
The role may require shift work, including night shifts, to ensure effective QHSE oversight.
Why Join Us?
Be part of a fast-growing and innovative digital laundry company.
Work in a dynamic and forward-thinking environment focused on sustainability and employee well-being.
Opportunities for growth and career advancement.
Competitive salary and benefits package will be offered based on qualifications, skills and experience.
If you are passionate about quality, health, safety, and environmental improvement and want to make a difference in a forward-thinking company, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now to join our team at Washmen.

title: Quality Assurance Manager
description:
Core Job Summary
The QA/QC Manager establishes, implements, and maintains the quality assurance systems and inspection protocols across all stages of production—from raw sheet metal receipt to the final painted and assembled enclosure—ensuring zero-defect delivery to clients. Also architects, enforces, and audits the plant's Quality Management System (QMS) to satisfy ISO 9001 and international structural steel and welding code metrics
The QA/QC Manager is responsible as well for the overall quality, structural integrity, and cosmetic finish of custom and standardized sheet metal enclosures. The role requires an analytical leader with deep technical knowledge of fabrication tolerances, welding standards, paint finish metrics, and final assembly compliance who can proactively prevent defects and resolve customer quality issues.
Key Responsibilities
In-Process Inspection Standards:
Establish and enforce Go/No-Go criteria for each production stage: flatness and dimensions after laser and CNC cutting, bend angles and tolerances at the press brakes, and weld integrity.
Paint & Finish Validation:
Oversee rigorous testing on the powder coating line, including dry film thickness (DFT) checks, cross-hatch adhesion tests, gloss level measurement, and color-matching audits.
Final Assembly Audit:
Implement rigorous final inspection protocols for enclosure seals, hardware alignment (hinges, latches, PEM fasteners), ingress protection (IP/NEMA ratings) consistency, and overall cosmetic perfection.
Defect Root Cause Analysis:
Lead investigations into internal non-conformances and customer returns using structured problem-solving tools to implement permanent corrective actions.
Supplier Quality Management:
Inspect and approve incoming raw materials (sheet steel, powder paint chemicals, gaskets, electronic components….etc)
Equipment Calibration:
Manage the calibration schedule for all precision measurement tools, including vernier calipers, height gauges, paint thickness meters
Certification Maintenance:
Maintain the facility’s quality certifications (such as ISO 9001) and lead internal and external quality audits.
Required Qualifications
Education:
Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or Manufacturing Engineering.
Experience:
5+ years of Quality Management experience specifically within precision sheet metal fabrication or enclosure manufacturing.
Technical Knowledge:
High level knowledge of geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, blueprint reading, AWS welding inspection standards, and powder coating testing methods. Active AWS Certified Welding Inspector (CWI) is mandatory
Language:
Strong command of English or Arabic.

About Sienci Labs
At Sienci Labs, we build software that empowers people to create, collaborate, and innovate. Our tools are used by a growing community of developers, businesses, and creators around the world. We're a small, fast-moving team that thrives on solving real-world problems through clean code, smart engineering, and a relentless focus on quality.
About the Role
We're looking for a sharp, detail-oriented QA Analyst who brings hands-on CNC experience to the table. This role is not just about testing code—it's about being the bridge between our software development team and other departments (customer support, product, manufacturing, sales, etc.).
You will proactively reach out to these teams to uncover bugs, understand how our software behaves in real CNC workflows, and ensure issues are caught early and communicated clearly. If you understand how CNC machines operate, how operators think, and how software can break in the real world, we want to talk to you.
What You'll Be Doing
Act as a liaison between the software development team and other departments (support, product, manufacturing, sales) to identify, prioritize, and document software bugs.
Proactively communicate with non-technical teams to gather real-world bug reports and usage feedback.
Write and maintain unit tests and automated test suites for our Electron, React, Node.js, and TypeScript stack.
Use Jira to track tasks, report bugs, and collaborate with developers.
Reproduce, document, and escalate bugs found in CNC-related software workflows.
Perform manual and automated testing across desktop (Electron) and web applications.
Help improve QA processes to catch issues earlier in development, especially those related to CNC toolpath generation, machine control, or user interface.
Keep test documentation up to date and advocate for best practices in testing.
What We're Looking For
CNC experience – required (you understand G-code, toolpaths, machine setup, and common failure modes in CNC workflows).
Knowledge of CNC firmware, specifically GRBL and GRBLHAL – strongly preferred (candidates with this experience can dive deeper into debugging and root cause analysis right away).
Experience with software QA methodologies and defect tracking.
Proficiency with Jira for task management and bug reporting.
Strong skills in unit testing frameworks (Jest, Mocha, etc.) and test automation.
Familiarity with our stack: Electron, React, Node.js, TypeScript.
Ability to work independently, troubleshoot issues, and propose solutions.
Clear communication skills – you can explain technical issues to developers, non-technical staff, and customers alike.
A proactive mindset – you don't wait for bugs to be reported; you seek them out from other teams.
Nice to Have
Experience with end-to-end testing tools (Cypress, Playwright, Selenium).
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated tests.
Background in customer-facing bug triage (working with support teams).
Experience with CAM software or other CNC controller software (e.g., Mach3, LinuxCNC).
Education & Experience
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience) – preferred.
3+ years in QA/testing roles (preferred).
2+ years in software development environments (preferred).
CNC experience – required.
GRBL/GRBLHAL knowledge – strongly preferred.
Why Work at Sienci Labs?
You'll be part of a tight-knit team where your work has a direct impact on thousands of users. You'll help shape how our software interacts with real-world CNC machines, and you'll be the voice connecting development to the rest of the company. Clean code, smart testing, continuous improvement—and no bureaucracy.
Benefits:
Casual dress
Company events
Dental care
Discounted or free food
Extended health care
Flexible schedule
On-site parking
Vision care

title: QA Analyst
description:
Job Description
Join Fortinet, a cybersecurity pioneer with over two decades of excellence, as we continue to shape the future of cybersecurity and redefine the intersection of networking and security. At Fortinet, our mission is to safeguard people, devices, and data everywhere. We are seeking our first dedicated QA Analyst to own the quality for our customer-facing portals. You will be responsible for creating automated tests, finding bugs, and ensuring our products meet high standards. Your work will directly improve our efficiency and product reliability.
Key Responsibilities:
Create and maintain automated test scripts using modern QA tools.
Write and execute clear test plans and test cases.
Document test processes, results, and release notes.
Work with product and support teams to reproduce and analyze issues.
Provide direct remote assistance to customers to troubleshoot problems.
Occasionally assist with development and deployment tasks.
Qualifications:
1-4 years of experience in a QA role.
Hands-on experience with automated testing tools (e.g., Selenium, Cypress).
Strong knowledge of QA methods, including writing test plans and bug reports.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
About Our Team:
Join our team, known for its collaborative ethos, working seamlessly with global customers, internal engineering teams and product development groups. Our team culture emphasizes continuous learning, innovation, and a strong commitment to customer satisfaction. We embrace Fortinet’s core values of openness, teamwork and innovation, fostering an environment where team members support each other, share knowledge, and leverage AI to solve complex technical challenges. Our inclusive and dynamic team thrives on collaboration and is driven by the shared goal of maintaining Fortinet’s high standards of excellence in cybersecurity solutions.
Why Join Us:
We encourage candidates from all backgrounds and identities to apply. We offer a supportive work environment and a competitive Total Rewards package to support you with your overall health and financial well-being. Embark on a challenging, enjoyable, and rewarding career journey with Fortinet. Join us in bringing solutions that make a meaningful and lasting impact to our 660,000+ customers around the globe.
The Canada base salary range for this full-time position is expected to be between $79,700 - $97,400 annually. Wage ranges are based on various factors including the labour market, job type, and job level. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate’s subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, and experience.
Fortinet strives to provide you and your family with a comprehensive benefits package. Benefits eligibility starts on your first day of hire and comprises of 100% company paid medical, dental, and vision coverage, including a Health Spending Account and a Personal Spending Account that gives you flexibility to spend where you need it the most. Our Employee & Family Assistance Plan (EFAP) offers you and your family access to various services like counseling, legal advice, mental health resources etc. We also provide critical illness, disability, and life insurance, as well as a Group Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) with a company match to help you save faster for retirement. We offer competitive Paid Time Off and flexible leave policies, including paid health days, to help you take care of yourself and your family members.
All roles are eligible to participate in the Fortinet equity program. Bonus eligibility is reviewed at time of hire and annually at the Company’s discretion.

title: Quality Assurance Analyst
description:

Responsibilities

Maintain logs of quality assurance functions.
Take ownership of the quality of product features.
